[Experiments](index.html)

This file contains the theory and all functions for the five experiments.
Every rational coefficient is read from the installed `rSPDE` BRASIL tables,
including their constant term. Knitting this file defines functions only.
The experiment notebooks load saved results; recomputation is explicit.

## Fractional diffusion equations on metric graphs

We analyze and numerically approximate solutions to fractional diffusion
equations on metric graphs of the form
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:maineq}
\tag{1}
\left\{
\begin{aligned}
    \partial_t u(s,t)+(\kappa^2-\Delta_\Gamma)^{\alpha/2}u(s,t)
        &=f(s,t), && (s,t)\in\Gamma\times(0,T),\\
    u(s,0)&=u_0(s), && s\in\Gamma.
\end{aligned}
\right.
\end{equation}
Here $\Gamma=(\mathcal V,\mathcal E)$ is a compact connected metric graph,
$\kappa>0$, $\alpha\in(0,2]$ is the fractional diffusion exponent, and
$f$ and $u_0$ are the right-hand side and initial condition, respectively.
The Kirchhoff--Laplacian $\Delta_\Gamma$ acts edgewise and has domain
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:Kcond}
\tag{2}
\mathcal D(\Delta_\Gamma)=
\left\{\phi\in C(\Gamma):\ \phi|_e\in H^2(e)\ \text{for every }e\in\mathcal E,
\quad\sum_{e\in\mathcal E_v}\partial_e\phi(v)=0
\ \text{for every }v\in\mathcal V\right\}.
\end{equation}
The derivatives in the vertex condition are directed from the vertex into
the incident edges, with each edge endpoint counted separately. We write
$L=\kappa^2-\Delta_\Gamma$ and $\beta=\alpha/2$. Fractional powers of $L$
are defined spectrally; the vertex conditions are incorporated through $L$.

## Numerical Scheme {#num_scheme}

Let $V_h$ be the space of continuous piecewise linear finite element
functions on a graph mesh indexed by $h$, and let $P_h$ denote the
$L_2(\Gamma)$-orthogonal projection onto $V_h$. Define the discrete operator
$L_h:V_h\to V_h$ by
\[
    (L_hv_h,w_h)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
    =\kappa^2(v_h,w_h)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
      +(v_h',w_h')_{L_2(\Gamma)},\qquad v_h,w_h\in V_h.
\]
Its fractional power induces the discrete bilinear form
\[
    \mathfrak a_{h,\alpha}(v_h,w_h)
    =(L_h^{\alpha/4}v_h,L_h^{\alpha/4}w_h)_{L_2(\Gamma)}.
\]
Thus, the spatial operator is discretized first and its fractional power
is then taken on $V_h$.

Let $t_k=k\tau$, $k=0,\ldots,N$, with $\tau=T/N$. The scheme computes
$U_h^\tau=\{U_h^k\}_{k=0}^{N}$, where $U_h^k\in V_h$ and
\[
\left\{
\begin{aligned}
    \left(\delta U_h^{k+1},\phi\right)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
      +\mathfrak a_{h,\alpha}(U_h^{k+1},\phi)
      &=(f^{k+1},\phi)_{L_2(\Gamma)},\qquad \phi\in V_h,\\
    U_h^0&=P_hu_0,
\end{aligned}
\right.
\]
for $k=0,\ldots,N-1$, with
\[
    \delta U_h^{k+1}=\frac{U_h^{k+1}-U_h^k}{\tau},
    \qquad f^{k+1}=\frac1\tau\int_{t_k}^{t_{k+1}}f(t)\,dt.
\]
Equivalently,
\begin{equation}
\label{system:fully_discrete_scheme}
\tag{3}
\left\{
\begin{aligned}
    (U_h^{k+1},\phi)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
      +\tau\mathfrak a_{h,\alpha}(U_h^{k+1},\phi)
      &=(U_h^k,\phi)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
        +\tau(f^{k+1},\phi)_{L_2(\Gamma)},\qquad\phi\in V_h,\\
    U_h^0&=P_hu_0.
\end{aligned}
\right.
\end{equation}

At each time step, the finite element solution can be expressed in the
basis $\{\psi_h^i\}_{i=1}^{N_h}$ as
\begin{equation}
\label{num_sol}
\tag{4}
    U_h^k(s)=\sum_{i=1}^{N_h}u_i^k\psi_h^i(s),\qquad s\in\Gamma.
\end{equation}
Replacing \eqref{num_sol} into \eqref{system:fully_discrete_scheme} yields
\[
    \sum_{j=1}^{N_h}u_j^{k+1}
    \left[(\psi_h^j,\psi_h^i)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
          +\tau\mathfrak a_{h,\alpha}(\psi_h^j,\psi_h^i)\right]
    =\sum_{j=1}^{N_h}u_j^k(\psi_h^j,\psi_h^i)_{L_2(\Gamma)}
      +\tau(f^{k+1},\psi_h^i)_{L_2(\Gamma)},
\]
for $i=1,\ldots,N_h$.

Introduce the mass and stiffness matrices
\[
    \mathbf C_{i,j}=(\psi_h^i,\psi_h^j)_{L_2(\Gamma)},\qquad
    \mathbf G_{i,j}=({\psi_h^i}',{\psi_h^j}')_{L_2(\Gamma)},\qquad
    \mathbf L=\kappa^2\mathbf C+\mathbf G.
\]
The coefficient matrix representing $L_h$ is
$\mathbf B=\mathbf C^{-1}\mathbf L$. Consequently, the matrix of the
fractional bilinear form is $\mathbf C\mathbf B^\beta$, and the scheme is
\begin{equation}
\label{diff_eq_discrete}
\tag{5}
    (\mathbf C+\tau\mathbf C\mathbf B^\beta)\mathbf U^{k+1}
    =\mathbf C\mathbf U^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1},
\end{equation}
where $\mathbf U^k$ has components $u_i^k$ and $\mathbf F^k$ has components
$(f^k,\psi_h^i)_{L_2(\Gamma)}$. In particular,
$\mathbf C(\mathbf C^{-1}\mathbf L)^\beta$ generally differs from the
ordinary matrix power $\mathbf L^\beta$.

Introduce the normalized matrix
$\mathbf A=\mathbf C^{-1}\mathbf L/\kappa^2$. Multiplying
\eqref{diff_eq_discrete} first by $\mathbf C^{-1}$ and then by
$\mathbf A^{-\beta}$ gives
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:inverse_scheme}
\tag{6}
    (\mathbf A^{-\beta}+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}\mathbf I)\mathbf U^{k+1}
    =\mathbf A^{-\beta}
      (\mathbf U^k+\tau\mathbf C^{-1}\mathbf F^{k+1}).
\end{equation}

### BRASIL rational approximation

Let $0<\beta<1$, and let $\lambda_{1,h}$ and $\lambda_{N_h,h}$ be the
smallest and largest eigenvalues of $L_h$. These are the generalized
eigenvalues of $(\mathbf L,\mathbf C)$, with
$\lambda_{1,h}=\kappa^2$. The interval
\[
    J_h=[\kappa^2\lambda_{N_h,h}^{-1},
         \kappa^2\lambda_{1,h}^{-1}]=[\delta_h,1]
\]
contains the spectrum of $\mathbf A^{-1}$.

Using the BRASIL coefficients supplied by rSPDE at exponent $\beta$, let
\[
    q_1(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{m}c_ix^i,\qquad
    q_2(x)=\sum_{j=0}^{m}b_jx^j,\qquad
    B_m(x)=\frac{q_1(x)}{q_2(x)}\approx x^\beta.
\]
Here the target is $x^\beta$ directly, and both polynomial degrees are at
most $m$. A fixed approximation on $[0,1]$ covers every $J_h$ and allows
the same coefficients to be used on different meshes. The numerical
tabulation or interpolation of coefficients need not give an exact
minimax approximation at every requested exponent.

In the normalized operator variable $y=1/x$, define
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:inverse_rational}
\tag{7}
    S_m(y)=B_m(y^{-1})
          =p_\ell(y)^{-1}p_r(y)\approx y^{-\beta},
    \qquad
    p_r(y)=y^m q_1(y^{-1}),\quad
    p_\ell(y)=y^m q_2(y^{-1}).
\end{equation}
The supplied partial fraction coefficients represent this same function as
\[
    S_m(y)=d_m+\sum_{j=1}^{m}\frac{\rho_j}{y-\eta_j},
    \qquad
    B_m(x)=d_m+\sum_{j=1}^{m}\frac{\rho_jx}{1-\eta_jx}.
\]
The source poles $\eta_j$, source residues $\rho_j$, and constant $d_m$
belong to the inverse-power approximation $S_m$. They are distinct from
the poles and residues of the time-step function derived below. Assuming
$q_2(0)\ne0$, the constant is
\[
    d_m=B_m(0)=\lim_{y\to\infty}S_m(y)=\frac{c_0}{b_0}.
\]

For comparison with the root-product notation, if $q_1$ and $q_2$ both
have degree $m$, with roots $\{r_{1i}\}_{i=1}^{m}$ and
$\{r_{2j}\}_{j=1}^{m}$ counted with multiplicity, then
\[
    p_r(y)=c_m\prod_{i=1}^{m}(1-r_{1i}y),\qquad
    p_\ell(y)=b_m\prod_{j=1}^{m}(1-r_{2j}y).
\]
Thus both products have $m$ factors, and the corresponding normalization
is $\mathrm{factor}=c_m/b_m$. Define
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:PLPR}
\tag{8}
    \mathbf P_r=\prod_{i=1}^{m}(\mathbf I-r_{1i}\mathbf A),
    \qquad
    \mathbf P_\ell=\frac{\kappa^{2\beta}}{\mathrm{factor}}\,
      \mathbf C\prod_{j=1}^{m}(\mathbf I-r_{2j}\mathbf A).
\end{equation}
This product representation is algebraic; the partial fraction
coefficients allow the same derivation without forming polynomial products.

Replacing $\mathbf A^{-\beta}$ in \eqref{eq:inverse_scheme} by
$S_m(\mathbf A)$ gives the rational scheme
\[
    (S_m(\mathbf A)+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}\mathbf I)\mathbf U_m^{k+1}
    =S_m(\mathbf A)
      (\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf C^{-1}\mathbf F^{k+1}),
\]
where $\mathbf U_m^0$ is the coefficient vector of $P_hu_0$. The subscript
$m$ distinguishes the rational approximation from the exact discrete
fractional scheme. In the root-product notation, this is equivalently
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:scheme}
\tag{9}
    (\mathbf P_r^\top\mathbf C+\tau\mathbf P_\ell^\top)
       \mathbf U_m^{k+1}
    =\mathbf P_r^\top(\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}).
\end{equation}
Indeed, setting $\mathbf D=\mathbf L\mathbf C^{-1}/\kappa^2$, we have
$\mathbf A^\top=\mathbf D$ and
$p(\mathbf D)\mathbf C=\mathbf C p(\mathbf A)$ for any polynomial $p$.
The factors that are polynomials in the same matrix commute; no commutation
of $\mathbf L$ with $\mathbf C^{-1}$ is assumed.

It follows that \eqref{eq:scheme} can be written as
\[
    (p_r(\mathbf D)+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}p_\ell(\mathbf D))
       \mathbf C\mathbf U_m^{k+1}
    =p_r(\mathbf D)(\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}),
\]
and hence
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:final_scheme}
\tag{10}
    \mathbf U_m^{k+1}=\mathbf C^{-1}
       (p_r(\mathbf D)+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}p_\ell(\mathbf D))^{-1}
       p_r(\mathbf D)(\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}).
\end{equation}
These inverses are well-defined if $S_m$ is finite and positive on the
spectrum of $\mathbf A$ and its reduced denominator has no zeros there.

### Partial fraction decomposition

Consider the scalar time-step function
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:partial_fraction}
\tag{11}
    H_m(y)=\frac{S_m(y)}{S_m(y)+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}}
          =\frac{p_r(y)}{p_r(y)+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}p_\ell(y)}
          =\sum_{n=1}^{m}\frac{a_n}{y-z_n}+r_\tau.
\end{equation}
The last equality assumes a reduced denominator of degree $m$ with simple
roots $z_n$ and $d_m+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}\ne0$. Lower degrees reduce the
number of terms; repeated poles require additional powers
$(y-z_n)^{-\ell}$ up to their multiplicity.

Unlike a strictly proper rational function, $H_m$ generally has a nonzero
constant term. Taking its limit at infinity yields
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:remainder}
\tag{12}
    r_\tau=\frac{d_m}{d_m+\tau\kappa^{2\beta}}.
\end{equation}
This time-step remainder is not the source constant $d_m$ itself.

Substituting \eqref{eq:partial_fraction} into \eqref{eq:final_scheme} gives
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:final_scheme2}
\tag{13}
    \mathbf U_m^{k+1}=\mathbf C^{-1}
      \left(\sum_{n=1}^{m}a_n
      (\mathbf L\mathbf C^{-1}/\kappa^2-z_n\mathbf I)^{-1}
      +r_\tau\mathbf I\right)
      (\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}).
\end{equation}
Since
\[
    (\mathbf L\mathbf C^{-1}/\kappa^2-z_n\mathbf I)^{-1}
    =\mathbf C(\mathbf L/\kappa^2-z_n\mathbf C)^{-1},
\]
we can rewrite \eqref{eq:final_scheme2} as
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:final_scheme3}
\tag{14}
    \mathbf U_m^{k+1}
    =\mathbf R_{m,\tau}(\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}),
    \qquad
    \mathbf R_{m,\tau}=r_\tau\mathbf C^{-1}
       +\sum_{n=1}^{m}a_n(\mathbf L/\kappa^2-z_n\mathbf C)^{-1}.
\end{equation}
Only sparse solves are required: one mass-matrix solve for the constant
term when $r_\tau\ne0$, and one shifted solve for each pole. For fixed
$h$, $\tau$, $\kappa$, $\beta$, and $m$, the matrices are unchanged between
time steps, so their factorizations can be reused.

### Poles and residues of the time-step function

To derive the poles directly from the source partial fractions, set
$s=\tau\kappa^{2\beta}>0$ and define
\[
    F_m(y)=S_m(y)+s
          =d_m+s+\sum_{j=1}^{m}\frac{\rho_j}{y-\eta_j}.
\]
The time-step poles $z_n$ solve $F_m(z_n)=0$. They are precisely the
zeros of the reduced combined denominator $p_r+s p_\ell$; the source
poles $\eta_j$ are removable singularities of $H_m$.

Suppose the source poles are distinct and ordered, and satisfy
\[
    \eta_1<\cdots<\eta_m<0,\qquad
    \rho_j>0,\qquad d_m\ge0.
\]
These are assumptions on the selected coefficients, not a guarantee for
every numerically tabulated or interpolated BRASIL approximation. On each
real interval between the source poles,
\[
    F_m'(y)=-\sum_{j=1}^{m}\frac{\rho_j}{(y-\eta_j)^2}<0.
\]
Moreover, $F_m(y)\to d_m+s>0$ as $y\to-\infty$,
$F_m(y)\to-\infty$ as $y\uparrow\eta_j$, and
$F_m(y)\to+\infty$ as $y\downarrow\eta_j$. Thus there is exactly one
simple zero in each of
\[
    (-\infty,\eta_1),\quad(\eta_1,\eta_2),\quad\ldots,
    \quad(\eta_{m-1},\eta_m),
\]
and no zero to the right of $\eta_m$. In particular,
\[
    z_1<\eta_1<z_2<\eta_2<\cdots<z_m<\eta_m<0.
\]
These roots can therefore be characterized by real scalar bracketing
without expanding the combined denominator into polynomial coefficients.

At a simple pole, $S_m(z_n)=-s$, so the residue is
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:residues}
\tag{15}
    a_n=\lim_{y\to z_n}(y-z_n)H_m(y)
        =\frac{S_m(z_n)}{S_m'(z_n)}
        =\frac{s}{\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{m}
                     \rho_j/(z_n-\eta_j)^2}>0.
\end{equation}
Consequently, $0\le r_\tau<1$, and every shifted matrix
$\mathbf L/\kappa^2-z_n\mathbf C$ is real symmetric positive definite.
The mass matrix is also positive definite, so all the solves in
\eqref{eq:final_scheme3} admit sparse Cholesky factorizations. In addition,
$S_m(y)>0$ for $y\ge1$, and hence $0<H_m(y)<1$ on the discrete spectrum.

The implementation rejects coefficient rows that fail these sign assumptions.

### Integer power and a fixed diffusion coefficient

For $\alpha=2$, we have $\beta=1$ and use the exact inverse $S(y)=y^{-1}$.
Then
\[
    H(y)=\frac{1}{1+\tau\kappa^2y}
        =\frac{1}{\tau\kappa^2}
          \left(y+\frac{1}{\tau\kappa^2}\right)^{-1},
\]
so the remainder is zero and the scheme reduces to ordinary backward Euler,
\[
    (\mathbf C+\tau\mathbf L)\mathbf U^{k+1}
    =\mathbf C\mathbf U^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}.
\]
If the physical equation instead contains a fixed diffusion coefficient
$\nu>0$, namely $u_t+\nu L^\beta u=f$, the same derivation replaces
$\tau\kappa^{2\beta}$ by $\tau\nu\kappa^{2\beta}$ in the time-step function,
its poles, residues, and remainder. The right-hand side remains
$\mathbf C\mathbf U_m^k+\tau\mathbf F^{k+1}$, and the integer-power matrix
is $\mathbf C+\tau\nu\mathbf L$.

# Implementation

## rSPDE BRASIL coefficients

```{r brasil-functions-0, eval=TRUE}
brasil_supported_orders <- function() {
    tables <- grep("^m_brasil[0-9]+t$", ls(asNamespace("rSPDE")), value = TRUE)
    sort(as.integer(sub("^m_brasil([0-9]+)t$", "\\1", tables)))
}

brasil_coefficients <- function(m, beta) {
    stopifnot(length(m) == 1L, is.finite(m), m %in% brasil_supported_orders(), length(beta) == 1L, is.finite(beta),
        beta > 0, beta < 1)
    table <- get(paste0("m_brasil", m, "t"), envir = asNamespace("rSPDE"))
    tolerance <- 32 * .Machine$double.eps * max(1, abs(beta))
    index <- which(abs(table$alpha - beta) <= tolerance)
    value <- function(column) {
        if (length(index) == 1L)
            table[[column]][index]
        else stats::approx(table$alpha, table[[column]], xout = beta)$y
    }
    poles <- vapply(paste0("p", seq_len(m)), value, numeric(1))
    residues <- vapply(paste0("r", seq_len(m)), value, numeric(1))
    constant <- value("k")
    if (any(!is.finite(c(poles, residues, constant))) || any(poles >= 0) || any(residues <= 0) || constant < 0 ||
        anyDuplicated(poles))
        stop("BRASIL table at m = ", m, ", beta = ", beta, " requires distinct negative poles, positive residues, and a nonnegative constant.")
    index <- order(poles)
    list(poles = unname(poles[index]), residues = unname(residues[index]), constant = unname(constant), m = as.integer(m),
        beta = beta)
}

brasil_inverse <- function(y, coefficients) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(y)), all(y > 0))
    coefficients$constant + as.numeric((1/outer(y, coefficients$poles, "-")) %*% coefficients$residues)
}

brasil_power <- function(x, coefficients) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(x)), all(x >= 0))
    coefficients$constant + as.numeric((x/(1 - outer(x, coefficients$poles))) %*% coefficients$residues)
}

brasil_partial_fractions <- function(coefficients, time_step, scaling) {
    strength <- time_step * scaling
    stopifnot(length(strength) == 1L, is.finite(strength), strength > 0)
    p <- coefficients$poles
    r <- coefficients$residues
    constant <- coefficients$constant
    poles <- numeric(length(p))
    denominator <- function(y) constant + strength + sum(r/(y - p))
    for (i in seq_along(p)) {
        upper <- p[i]
        lower <- if (i == 1L)
            2 * upper
        else p[i - 1L]
        if (i == 1L)
            while (denominator(lower) <= 0) lower <- 2 * lower
        width <- upper - lower
        normalized <- function(t) {
            if (t == 0 && i > 1L)
                return(.Machine$double.xmax)
            if (t == 1)
                return(-.Machine$double.xmax)
            denominator(lower + width * t)
        }
        root <- stats::uniroot(normalized, c(0, 1), tol = 2 * .Machine$double.eps, maxiter = 1000L)$root
        poles[i] <- lower + width * root
    }
    residues <- vapply(poles, function(z) strength/sum(r/(z - p)^2), numeric(1))
    remainder <- constant/(constant + strength)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(poles, residues, remainder))), all(poles < 0), all(residues > 0), remainder >= 0,
        remainder < 1)
    y <- 10^seq(0, 12, length.out = 257L)
    inverse <- brasil_inverse(y, coefficients)
    expected <- inverse/(inverse + strength)
    actual <- remainder + as.numeric((1/outer(y, poles, "-")) %*% residues)
    reconstruction_error <- max(abs(actual - expected))
    if (reconstruction_error > 2e-12)
        stop("Inaccurate BRASIL time-step partial fractions: ", reconstruction_error)
    list(p = poles, r = residues, k = remainder, reconstruction_error = reconstruction_error)
}
```

## Consistent FEM and backward Euler

```{r brasil-functions-1, eval=TRUE}
my.fractional.operators.frac <- function(L, beta, C, scale.factor, m = 1, time_step, diffusion = 1) {
    stopifnot(length(diffusion) == 1L, is.finite(diffusion), diffusion > 0, length(time_step) == 1L, is.finite(time_step),
        time_step > 0, length(beta) == 1L, is.finite(beta), beta > 0, beta <= 1, length(scale.factor) == 1L, is.finite(scale.factor),
        scale.factor > 0)
    L <- L/scale.factor
    if (beta == 1) {
        L <- L * scale.factor^beta
        lhs <- C + time_step * diffusion * L
        return(list(C = C, L = L, m = m, beta = beta, diffusion = diffusion, LHS = lhs, factorization = Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(lhs),
            LDL = FALSE)))
    }
    scaling <- diffusion * scale.factor^beta
    coefficients <- brasil_coefficients(m, beta)
    poles_rs_k <- brasil_partial_fractions(coefficients, time_step, scaling)
    partial_fraction_terms <- lapply(poles_rs_k$p, function(p) L - p * C)
    remainder <- if (length(poles_rs_k$k))
        poles_rs_k$k
    else 0
    list(C = C, L = L, m = m, beta = beta, diffusion = diffusion, partial_fraction_terms = partial_fraction_terms,
        residues = poles_rs_k$r, poles = poles_rs_k$p, remainder = remainder, mass_factor = if (remainder != 0) Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(C),
            LDL = FALSE) else NULL, factorizations = lapply(partial_fraction_terms, function(A) Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(A),
            LDL = FALSE)))
}

my.solver.frac <- function(obj, v) {
    if (obj$beta == 1) {
        return(if (!is.null(obj$factorization)) Matrix::solve(obj$factorization, v, system = "A") else Matrix::solve(obj$LHS, v))
    }
    partial_fraction_terms <- obj$partial_fraction_terms
    residues <- obj$residues
    output <- v * 0
    if (!is.null(obj$remainder) && obj$remainder != 0) {
        mass_solved <- if (!is.null(obj$mass_factor))
            Matrix::solve(obj$mass_factor, v, system = "A")
        else Matrix::solve(obj$C, v)
        output <- obj$remainder * mass_solved
    }
    for (i in seq_along(residues)) {
        solved <- if (!is.null(obj$factorizations)) {
            Matrix::solve(obj$factorizations[[i]], v, system = "A")
        }
        else Matrix::solve(partial_fraction_terms[[i]], v)
        output <- output + residues[i] * solved
    }
    return(output)
}

solve_fractional_evolution <- function(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0, RHST) {
    CC <- my_op_frac$C
    SOL <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(CC), ncol = length(time_seq))
    SOL[, 1] <- val_at_0
    for (k in 1:(length(time_seq) - 1)) {
        rhs <- CC %*% SOL[, k] + time_step * RHST[, k + 1]
        SOL[, k + 1] <- as.matrix(my.solver.frac(my_op_frac, rhs))
    }
    return(SOL)
}

estimate_error_memory <- function(n_reference_nodes, n_reference_samples, n_blocks, n_solver_steps = numeric(0),
    matrix_copies = 6, baseline_gib = 0, n_exact_modes = NULL) {
    positive_counts <- function(x) {
        is.numeric(x) && length(x) > 0L && all(is.finite(x)) && all(x >= 1) && all(x == floor(x))
    }
    stopifnot(positive_counts(n_reference_nodes), length(n_reference_nodes) == 1L, positive_counts(n_reference_samples),
        length(n_reference_samples) == 1L, positive_counts(n_blocks), is.numeric(n_solver_steps), length(n_solver_steps) ==
            0L || positive_counts(n_solver_steps), is.numeric(matrix_copies), length(matrix_copies) == 1L, is.finite(matrix_copies),
        matrix_copies >= 1, is.numeric(baseline_gib), length(baseline_gib) == 1L, is.finite(baseline_gib), baseline_gib >=
            0)
    if (!is.null(n_exact_modes))
        stopifnot(positive_counts(n_exact_modes), length(n_exact_modes) == 1L)
    samples <- as.double(n_reference_samples)
    blocks <- pmin(as.double(n_blocks), samples)
    per_block <- ceiling(samples/blocks)
    gib <- 1024^3
    block_rows <- if (is.null(n_exact_modes))
        n_reference_nodes
    else n_exact_modes
    matrix_bytes <- 8 * as.double(block_rows) * per_block
    block_bytes <- matrix_copies * matrix_bytes + 128 * per_block
    time_bytes <- 8 * (samples + 1 + 2 * sum(as.double(n_solver_steps) + 1))
    data.frame(error_method = if (is.null(n_exact_modes))
        "reference"
    else "compressed", requested_blocks = as.double(n_blocks), n_blocks = blocks, samples_per_block = per_block,
        matrix_gib = matrix_bytes/gib, block_workspace_gib = block_bytes/gib, time_vectors_gib = time_bytes/gib,
        baseline_gib = baseline_gib, estimated_gib = (block_bytes + time_bytes)/gib + baseline_gib)
}

prepare_reference_error <- function(Psi, reference_C, reference_basis) {
    E <- as.matrix(reference_basis)
    stopifnot(nrow(Psi) == nrow(reference_C), nrow(reference_C) == ncol(reference_C), nrow(E) == nrow(Psi), ncol(E) >=
        1L, all(is.finite(E)))
    metric <- Matrix::forceSymmetric(as(Matrix::Matrix(Matrix::crossprod(Psi, reference_C %*% Psi), sparse = TRUE),
        "CsparseMatrix"))
    cross <- Matrix::crossprod(Psi, reference_C %*% E)
    factor <- Matrix::Cholesky(metric, LDL = FALSE)
    projection <- as.matrix(Matrix::solve(factor, cross, system = "A"))
    residual <- E - as.matrix(Psi %*% projection)
    list(metric = metric, projection = projection, residual_gram = as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(residual, reference_C %*%
        residual)), exact_gram = as.matrix(Matrix::crossprod(E, reference_C %*% E)))
}

reference_coefficient_moments <- function(coefficients, weights) {
    coefficients <- as.matrix(coefficients)
    stopifnot(nrow(coefficients) >= 1L, ncol(coefficients) == length(weights), length(weights) >= 1L, all(is.finite(coefficients)),
        all(is.finite(weights)), all(weights > 0))
    weight <- sum(weights)
    centered <- sweep(coefficients, 1L, coefficients[, 1L], `-`)
    shift <- as.numeric(centered %*% (weights/weight))
    deviations <- sweep(centered, 1L, shift, `-`)
    list(weight = weight, mean = coefficients[, 1L] + shift, scatter = tcrossprod(sweep(deviations, 2L, sqrt(weights),
        `*`)))
}

merge_reference_moments <- function(left, right) {
    if (is.null(left))
        return(right)
    weight <- left$weight + right$weight
    delta <- right$mean - left$mean
    list(weight = weight, mean = left$mean + (right$weight/weight) * delta, scatter = left$scatter + right$scatter +
        (left$weight * (right$weight/weight)) * tcrossprod(delta))
}

reference_interval_error <- function(u, moments, projection) {
    delta <- as.numeric(u - projection$projection %*% moments$mean)
    metric_product <- as.numeric(projection$metric %*% delta)
    residual_product <- as.numeric(projection$residual_gram %*% moments$mean)
    variance_terms <- projection$exact_gram * moments$scatter
    value <- moments$weight * (sum(delta * metric_product) + sum(moments$mean * residual_product)) + sum(variance_terms)
    scale <- moments$weight * (sum(abs(delta * metric_product)) + sum(abs(moments$mean * residual_product))) +
        sum(abs(variance_terms))
    if (!is.finite(value) || value < -128 * .Machine$double.eps * scale)
        stop("Invalid compressed reference-grid squared error.")
    max(0, value)
}

solve_compressed_reference_error <- function(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0, spatial_load, g_average,
    reference_times, coefficients_at_time, error_projection, n_blocks = 1000L, verbose = FALSE) {
    stopifnot(nrow(error_projection$metric) == length(val_at_0), ncol(error_projection$metric) == length(val_at_0),
        nrow(error_projection$projection) == length(val_at_0))
    n_modes <- ncol(error_projection$projection)
    stopifnot(identical(dim(error_projection$exact_gram), c(n_modes, n_modes)), identical(dim(error_projection$residual_gram),
        c(n_modes, n_modes)))
    n_samples <- length(reference_times) - 1L
    n_blocks <- min(n_blocks, n_samples)
    u <- as.numeric(val_at_0)
    spatial_load <- as.numeric(spatial_load)
    solver_step <- 0L
    active_step <- NULL
    moments <- NULL
    total <- compensation <- 0
    next_ref <- 2L
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    finish_interval <- function() {
        value <- reference_interval_error(u, moments, error_projection)
        adjusted <- value - compensation
        updated <- total + adjusted
        compensation <<- (updated - total) - adjusted
        total <<- updated
    }
    for (block in seq_len(n_blocks)) {
        last_ref <- if (block == n_blocks)
            length(reference_times)
        else 1L + floor(block * n_samples/n_blocks)
        ids <- seq.int(next_ref, last_ref)
        times <- reference_times[ids]
        weights <- times - reference_times[ids - 1L]
        coefficients <- as.matrix(coefficients_at_time(times))
        stopifnot(nrow(coefficients) == n_modes, ncol(coefficients) == length(times), all(is.finite(coefficients)))
        runs <- rle(findInterval(times, time_seq, left.open = TRUE))
        first_column <- 1L
        for (run in seq_along(runs$values)) {
            target <- runs$values[run]
            if (is.null(active_step) || target != active_step) {
                if (!is.null(active_step))
                  finish_interval()
                while (solver_step < target) {
                  solver_step <- solver_step + 1L
                  rhs <- my_op_frac$C %*% u + time_step * spatial_load * g_average[solver_step + 1L]
                  u <- as.numeric(my.solver.frac(my_op_frac, rhs))
                }
                active_step <- target
                moments <- NULL
            }
            last_column <- first_column + runs$lengths[run] - 1L
            columns <- seq.int(first_column, last_column)
            moments <- merge_reference_moments(moments, reference_coefficient_moments(coefficients[, columns, drop = FALSE],
                weights[columns]))
            first_column <- last_column + 1L
        }
        next_ref <- last_ref + 1L
        if (verbose)
            message(sprintf("Compressed reference error: block %s/%s, %.1f%%, solver step %s/%s, %.2f s elapsed",
                block, n_blocks, 100 * (last_ref - 1L)/n_samples, solver_step, length(time_seq) - 1L, proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
                  started))
    }
    finish_interval()
    stopifnot(next_ref == length(reference_times) + 1L, solver_step == length(time_seq) - 1L)
    sqrt(total)
}

solve_fractional_evolution_error <- function(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0, spatial_load, g_average,
    Psi, reference_C, reference_times, exact_at_time = NULL, n_blocks = 1000L, verbose = FALSE, error_method = c("reference",
        "compressed"), reference_basis = NULL, coefficients_at_time = NULL, error_projection = NULL) {
    error_method <- match.arg(error_method)
    stopifnot(length(time_step) == 1L, is.finite(time_step), time_step > 0, length(time_seq) >= 2L, length(reference_times) >=
        2L, all(is.finite(time_seq)), all(is.finite(reference_times)), all(diff(time_seq) > 0), all(diff(reference_times) >
        0), reference_times[1] == time_seq[1], tail(reference_times, 1) == tail(time_seq, 1), length(g_average) ==
        length(time_seq), length(val_at_0) == nrow(my_op_frac$C), length(spatial_load) == length(val_at_0), ncol(Psi) ==
        length(val_at_0), nrow(Psi) == nrow(reference_C), nrow(reference_C) == ncol(reference_C), if (error_method ==
        "reference")
        is.function(exact_at_time)
    else is.function(coefficients_at_time), length(n_blocks) == 1L, is.finite(n_blocks), n_blocks >= 1, n_blocks ==
        floor(n_blocks), is.logical(verbose), length(verbose) == 1L, !is.na(verbose))
    if (error_method == "compressed") {
        if (is.null(error_projection)) {
            if (is.null(reference_basis))
                stop("Compressed error needs reference_basis or error_projection.")
            error_projection <- prepare_reference_error(Psi, reference_C, reference_basis)
        }
        return(solve_compressed_reference_error(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0, spatial_load, g_average,
            reference_times, coefficients_at_time, error_projection, n_blocks, verbose))
    }
    n_samples <- length(reference_times) - 1L
    n_blocks <- min(n_blocks, n_samples)
    samples_per_block <- n_samples/n_blocks
    n_steps <- length(time_seq) - 1L
    u <- as.numeric(val_at_0)
    spatial_load <- as.numeric(spatial_load)
    solver_step <- 0L
    projected_step <- -1L
    u_ref <- NULL
    next_ref <- 2L
    error_sum <- 0
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    if (verbose) {
        message(sprintf("Error accumulation: %s reference samples in %s blocks; up to %s samples/block (%.2f GiB per dense matrix).",
            format(n_samples, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), format(n_blocks, big.mark = ",",
                scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), format(ceiling(samples_per_block), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE,
                trim = TRUE), 8 * nrow(reference_C) * ceiling(samples_per_block)/1024^3))
    }
    for (block in seq_len(n_blocks)) {
        last_ref <- if (block == n_blocks) {
            length(reference_times)
        }
        else {
            1L + floor(block * samples_per_block)
        }
        ids <- seq.int(next_ref, last_ref)
        times <- reference_times[ids]
        target_steps <- findInterval(times, time_seq, left.open = TRUE)
        runs <- rle(target_steps)
        error <- as.matrix(exact_at_time(times))
        stopifnot(nrow(error) == nrow(reference_C), ncol(error) == length(ids))
        first_column <- 1L
        for (run in seq_along(runs$values)) {
            target <- runs$values[run]
            while (solver_step < target) {
                solver_step <- solver_step + 1L
                rhs <- my_op_frac$C %*% u + time_step * spatial_load * g_average[solver_step + 1L]
                u <- as.numeric(my.solver.frac(my_op_frac, rhs))
            }
            if (projected_step != target) {
                u_ref <- as.numeric(Psi %*% u)
                projected_step <- target
            }
            last_column <- first_column + runs$lengths[run] - 1L
            columns <- seq.int(first_column, last_column)
            error[, columns] <- error[, columns, drop = FALSE] - u_ref
            first_column <- last_column + 1L
        }
        squared <- colSums(error * (reference_C %*% error))
        weights <- times - reference_times[ids - 1L]
        error_sum <- error_sum + sum(weights * squared)
        rm(error)
        next_ref <- last_ref + 1L
        if (verbose) {
            processed <- last_ref - 1L
            elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
            remaining <- elapsed * (n_samples/processed - 1)
            message(sprintf("Block %s/%s | %.1f%% | %s/%s samples | solver step %s/%s | elapsed %.1f min | ETA %.1f min",
                block, n_blocks, 100 * processed/n_samples, format(processed, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE,
                  trim = TRUE), format(n_samples, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), solver_step,
                n_steps, elapsed/60, remaining/60))
        }
    }
    stopifnot(next_ref == length(reference_times) + 1L, solver_step == n_steps)
    sqrt(error_sum)
}

construct_piecewise_projection <- function(projected_U_approx, time_seq, overkill_time_seq) {
    stopifnot(length(time_seq) >= 2L, ncol(projected_U_approx) == length(time_seq), all(is.finite(time_seq)), all(diff(time_seq) >
        0), all(is.finite(overkill_time_seq)), all(overkill_time_seq >= time_seq[1]), all(overkill_time_seq <=
        tail(time_seq, 1)))
    columns <- findInterval(overkill_time_seq, time_seq, left.open = TRUE) + 1L
    projected_U_approx[, columns, drop = FALSE]
}

make_time_grid <- function(T_final, target_step) {
    stopifnot(length(T_final) == 1L, is.finite(T_final), T_final > 0, length(target_step) == 1L, is.finite(target_step),
        target_step > 0)
    N <- ceiling(T_final/target_step)
    time_step <- T_final/N
    time_seq <- seq(0, T_final, length.out = N + 1)
    return(list(N = N, time_step = time_step, time_seq = time_seq))
}

average_sine_forcing <- function(time_seq, A = 1, omega = pi) {
    dt <- diff(time_seq)
    stopifnot(length(time_seq) >= 2L, all(is.finite(time_seq)), all(dt > 0))
    midpoint <- head(time_seq, -1) + dt/2
    z <- omega * dt/2
    sinc_z <- rep(1, length(z))
    nonzero <- z != 0
    sinc_z[nonzero] <- sin(z[nonzero])/z[nonzero]
    averages <- A * sin(omega * midpoint) * sinc_z
    c(0, averages)
}
```

```{r brasil-functions-2, eval=TRUE}
gets.graph.tadpole <- function(h) {
  stopifnot(length(h)==1L, is.finite(h), h>0)
  if ("edges" %in% names(formals(MetricGraph::metric_graph$public_methods$initialize))) {
    theta <- seq(-pi,pi,length.out=10000L)
    edges <- list(rbind(c(0,0),c(1,0)), cbind(1+1/pi+cos(theta)/pi,sin(theta)/pi))
    graph <- MetricGraph::metric_graph$new(edges=edges,verbose=0)
    graph$set_manual_edge_lengths(edge_lengths=c(1,2))
    graph$build_mesh(h=h)
    return(graph)
  }
  counts <- as.integer(ceiling(c(1,2)/h))
  n <- as.integer(2+sum(counts-1L))
  inside <- list(if(counts[1]>1L) seq.int(3L,counts[1]+1L) else integer(),
                 if(counts[2]>1L) seq.int(counts[1]+2L,n) else integer())
  paths <- list(c(1L,inside[[1]],2L), c(2L,inside[[2]],2L))
  E <- do.call(rbind,lapply(paths,function(v)cbind(head(v,-1L),tail(v,-1L))))
  lengths <- rep(c(1,2)/counts,counts)
  fem <- get("assemble_fem",asNamespace("MetricGraph"))(E,lengths,n)
  PtE <- do.call(rbind,lapply(1:2,function(e)cbind(e,seq_len(counts[e]-1L)/counts[e])))
  locations <- rbind(c(1,0),c(2,0),PtE)
  basis <- function(points) {
    edge <- as.integer(points[,1]); t <- points[,2]*counts[edge]
    cell <- pmin(floor(t),counts[edge]-1L); weight <- t-cell
    left <- right <- integer(nrow(points))
    for(e in 1:2) {
      ids <- which(edge==e)
      left[ids] <- paths[[e]][cell[ids]+1L]
      right[ids] <- paths[[e]][cell[ids]+2L]
    }
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=rep(seq_len(nrow(points)),2L),j=c(left,right),
      x=c(1-weight,weight),dims=c(nrow(points),n))
  }
  list(mesh=c(fem,list(PtE=PtE,h_e=lengths)),compute_fem=function()invisible(NULL),
       get_edge_lengths=function()c(1,2),get_mesh_locations=function()locations,fem_basis=basis)
}

tadpole.eig <- function(k, graph) {
    x1 <- c(0, graph$get_edge_lengths()[1] * graph$mesh$PtE[graph$mesh$PtE[, 1] == 1, 2])
    x2 <- c(0, graph$get_edge_lengths()[2] * graph$mesh$PtE[graph$mesh$PtE[, 1] == 2, 2])
    if (k == 0) {
        f.e1 <- rep(1, length(x1))
        f.e2 <- rep(1, length(x2))
        f1 = c(f.e1[1], f.e2[1], f.e1[-1], f.e2[-1])
        f = list(phi = f1/sqrt(3))
    }
    else {
        f.e1 <- -2 * sin(pi * k * 1/2) * cos(pi * k * x1/2)
        f.e2 <- sin(pi * k * x2/2)
        f1 = c(f.e1[1], f.e2[1], f.e1[-1], f.e2[-1])
        if ((k%%2) == 1) {
            f = list(phi = f1/sqrt(3))
        }
        else {
            f.e1 <- (-1)^{
                k/2
            } * cos(pi * k * x1/2)
            f.e2 <- cos(pi * k * x2/2)
            f2 = c(f.e1[1], f.e2[1], f.e1[-1], f.e2[-1])
            f <- list(phi = f1, psi = f2/sqrt(3/2))
        }
    }
    return(f)
}

gets.eigen.params <- function(N_finite = 4, kappa = 1, alpha = 0.5, graph) {
    EIGENVAL <- NULL
    EIGENVAL_ALPHA <- NULL
    EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA <- NULL
    EIGENFUN <- NULL
    INDEX <- NULL
    for (j in 0:N_finite) {
        lambda_j <- kappa^2 + (j * pi/2)^2
        lambda_j_alpha_half <- lambda_j^(alpha/2)
        lambda_j_minus_alpha_half <- lambda_j^(-alpha/2)
        e_j <- tadpole.eig(j, graph)$phi
        EIGENVAL <- c(EIGENVAL, lambda_j)
        EIGENVAL_ALPHA <- c(EIGENVAL_ALPHA, lambda_j_alpha_half)
        EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA <- c(EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA, lambda_j_minus_alpha_half)
        EIGENFUN <- cbind(EIGENFUN, e_j)
        INDEX <- c(INDEX, j)
        if (j > 0 && (j%%2 == 0)) {
            lambda_j <- kappa^2 + (j * pi/2)^2
            lambda_j_alpha_half <- lambda_j^(alpha/2)
            lambda_j_minus_alpha_half <- lambda_j^(-alpha/2)
            e_j <- tadpole.eig(j, graph)$psi
            EIGENVAL <- c(EIGENVAL, lambda_j)
            EIGENVAL_ALPHA <- c(EIGENVAL_ALPHA, lambda_j_alpha_half)
            EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA <- c(EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA, lambda_j_minus_alpha_half)
            EIGENFUN <- cbind(EIGENFUN, e_j)
            INDEX <- c(INDEX, j + 0.1)
        }
    }
    return(list(EIGENVAL = EIGENVAL, EIGENVAL_ALPHA = EIGENVAL_ALPHA, EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA = EIGENVAL_MINUS_ALPHA,
        EIGENFUN = EIGENFUN, INDEX = INDEX))
}

trig_hat_integrals <- function(a, b, w, A = 0, B = 0) {
    h <- b - a
    z <- w * h/2
    theta <- w * (a + b)/2
    if (abs(z) < 0.001) {
        S <- 1 - z^2/6 + z^4/120 - z^6/5040
        Q <- z/3 - z^3/30 + z^5/840 - z^7/45360
    }
    else {
        S <- sin(z)/z
        Q <- (sin(z) - z * cos(z))/z^2
    }
    v <- A * cos(theta) + B * sin(theta)
    q <- A * sin(theta) - B * cos(theta)
    h/2 * c(left = S * v + Q * q, right = S * v - Q * q)
}

project_u0_tadpole <- function(graph, amplitude = 10) {
    C <- graph$mesh$C
    PtE <- graph$mesh$PtE
    lengths <- graph$get_edge_lengths()
    stopifnot(!is.null(C), length(lengths) == 2L, nrow(C) == 2L + nrow(PtE), length(amplitude) == 1L, is.finite(amplitude))
    local_load <- function(a, b, w, A, B) {
        h <- b - a
        z <- w * h/2
        theta <- w * (a + b)/2
        if (abs(z) < 0.001) {
            S <- 1 - z^2/6 + z^4/120 - z^6/5040
            Q <- z/3 - z^3/30 + z^5/840 - z^7/45360
        }
        else {
            S <- sin(z)/z
            Q <- (sin(z) - z * cos(z))/z^2
        }
        v <- A * cos(theta) + B * sin(theta)
        q <- A * sin(theta) - B * cos(theta)
        h/2 * c(S * v + Q * q, S * v - Q * q)
    }
    b0 <- numeric(nrow(C))
    w <- 3 * pi/2
    for (edge in 1:2) {
        idx <- which(PtE[, 1] == edge)
        idx <- idx[order(PtE[idx, 2])]
        x <- c(0, lengths[edge] * PtE[idx, 2], lengths[edge])
        start_node <- if (edge == 1L)
            1L
        else 2L
        nodes <- c(start_node, 2L + idx, 2L)
        A <- if (edge == 1L)
            2 * amplitude/sqrt(3)
        else 0
        B <- if (edge == 2L)
            amplitude/sqrt(3)
        else 0
        for (j in seq_len(length(x) - 1L)) {
            load <- local_load(x[j], x[j + 1L], w, A, B)
            b0[nodes[j]] <- b0[nodes[j]] + load[1]
            b0[nodes[j + 1L]] <- b0[nodes[j + 1L]] + load[2]
        }
    }
    as.numeric(Matrix::solve(C, b0))
}

assemble_e7_load_tadpole <- function(graph) {
    C <- graph$mesh$C
    PtE <- graph$mesh$PtE
    lengths <- graph$get_edge_lengths()
    stopifnot(!is.null(C), length(lengths) == 2L, nrow(C) == 2L + nrow(PtE))
    b7 <- numeric(nrow(C))
    for (edge in 1:2) {
        idx <- which(PtE[, 1] == edge)
        idx <- idx[order(PtE[idx, 2])]
        x <- c(0, lengths[edge] * PtE[idx, 2], lengths[edge])
        start_node <- if (edge == 1L)
            1L
        else 2L
        nodes <- c(start_node, 2L + idx, 2L)
        for (j in seq_len(length(x) - 1L)) {
            load <- trig_hat_integrals(x[j], x[j + 1L], w = 2 * pi, A = sqrt(2/3), B = 0)
            b7[nodes[j]] <- b7[nodes[j]] + load[1]
            b7[nodes[j + 1L]] <- b7[nodes[j + 1L]] + load[2]
        }
    }
    b7
}

decayed_sine_convolution <- function(t, rate, A = 1, omega = pi) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(t)), all(t >= 0), length(rate) == 1L, is.finite(rate), rate >= 0, is.finite(A), is.finite(omega))
    z <- (rate + (0+1i) * omega) * t
    small <- Mod(z) < 0.5
    answer <- numeric(length(t))
    if (any(small)) {
        zz <- z[small]
        term <- rep(1 + (0+0i), length(zz))
        series <- rep(0 + (0+0i), length(zz))
        for (k in 1:24) {
            term <- term * zz/(k + 1)
            series <- series + term
        }
        answer[small] <- A * exp(-rate * t[small]) * t[small] * Im(series)
    }
    if (any(!small)) {
        tt <- t[!small]
        answer[!small] <- A * Im((exp((0+1i) * omega * tt) - exp(-rate * tt))/(rate + (0+1i) * omega))
    }
    answer
}

exact_modal_coefficients <- function(t, rates, initial, forcing, A = 1, omega = pi) {
    stopifnot(length(rates) == length(initial), length(rates) == length(forcing), all(is.finite(rates)), all(rates >
        0))
    out <- matrix(0, nrow = length(rates), ncol = length(t))
    for (j in seq_along(rates)) {
        out[j, ] <- initial[j] * exp(-rates[j] * t) + forcing[j] * decayed_sine_convolution(t, rates[j], A = A,
            omega = omega)
    }
    out
}

run_reference_cases <- function(cases, FUN, workers = 1L) {
    stopifnot(is.function(FUN), length(workers) == 1L, is.finite(workers), workers >= 1L, workers == as.integer(workers))
    if (!length(cases))
        return(list())
    workers <- min(as.integer(workers), length(cases))
    task <- function(x) tryCatch(list(value = FUN(x)), error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e)))
    if (workers > 1L) {
        if (.Platform$OS.type != "unix")
            stop("Parallel reference cases require Unix fork workers; set workers = 1 on this platform.")
        results <- parallel::mclapply(cases, task, mc.cores = workers, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
    }
    else results <- lapply(cases, task)
    failed <- which(vapply(results, function(x) inherits(x, "try-error") || !is.list(x) || !is.null(x$error) ||
        !("value" %in% names(x)), logical(1)))
    if (length(failed)) {
        i <- failed[1L]
        detail <- if (is.list(results[[i]]))
            results[[i]]$error
        else as.character(results[[i]])
        stop("Reference case ", i, " failed: ", paste(detail, collapse = " "), call. = FALSE)
    }
    lapply(results, `[[`, "value")
}
```

```{r brasil-functions-3, eval=TRUE}
save_smooth_figure <- function(errors,axis,alpha,study) {
  frame <- expand.grid(row=seq_along(axis),column=seq_along(alpha))
  frame$x <- axis[frame$row]
  frame$error <- as.vector(errors)
  frame$alpha <- factor(alpha[frame$column],levels=alpha)
  guide <- frame
  rate <- if(study=="h") 2 else 1
  for(j in seq_along(alpha)) {
    ids <- frame$column==j
    constant <- exp(mean(log(errors[,j]/axis^rate)))
    guide$error[ids] <- constant*guide$x[ids]^rate
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(frame,ggplot2::aes(x,error,color=alpha,group=alpha))+
    ggplot2::geom_line(data=guide,linetype="dashed")+ggplot2::geom_line()+
    ggplot2::geom_point()+ggplot2::scale_x_log10()+ggplot2::scale_y_log10()+
    ggplot2::labs(x=study,y="Space-time L2 error",color="alpha")+
    ggplot2::theme_bw()+ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom")
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("data_files","tikzpic",
    paste0("p_",study,"_nicer_tadpole_mat_with_mathpazo.png")),plot,
    width=4,height=5,dpi=300,bg="white")
  invisible(plot)
}

run_smooth_h <- function(workers=1L,output_file="data_files/errors_projected_h_mat.RData") {
# Parameters
T_final <- 1
diffusion <- 1e-3 # nu > 0 in u_t + nu * L^(alpha/2) u = f
workers <- workers
error_method <- "compressed" # "reference" retains the original error accumulator
kappa <- 4
N_finite <- 4 # choose even
adjusted_N_finite <- N_finite + N_finite/2 + 1
# Coefficients for u_0 and f
coeff_U_0 <- 50*(1:adjusted_N_finite)^-1
coeff_U_0[-5] <- 0
coeff_FF <- rep(0, adjusted_N_finite)
coeff_FF[7] <- 10

AAA = 1
OMEGA = pi

h_vector <- 2^seq(-7, -3)
alpha_vector <- seq(0.5, 1.9, 0.2)

# Keep the rational order and actual uniform time grid fixed across all runs.
m_fixed <- 8
time_step_target <- 2e-5
time_grid <- make_time_grid(T_final = T_final, target_step = time_step_target)
time_step <- time_grid$time_step
time_seq <- time_grid$time_seq
g_average <- average_sine_forcing(time_seq, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA)

# The analytic initial projection currently supports only the fifth eigenfunction.
stopifnot(all(coeff_U_0[-5] == 0))
# The analytic forcing load currently supports only the seventh eigenfunction.
stopifnot(length(coeff_FF) >= 7L, all(coeff_FF[-7] == 0))

# Reference quadrature and error accumulation.
overkill_time_step <- 1e-5
overkill_h <- 1e-5
error_verbose <- FALSE # Report completed blocks, percentage, elapsed time, and ETA.
error_n_blocks <- 1L # More blocks use less memory; blocks may span solver intervals.
# Heavy setup and convergence computation: run manually to replace saved results.
overkill_graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = overkill_h)
overkill_graph$compute_fem()
overkill_C <- overkill_graph$mesh$C

# Preview modeled memory before allocating the reference time vector or solving.
# estimated_gib excludes FEM/solver objects and other session memory by default.
error_memory <- estimate_error_memory(
  n_reference_nodes = nrow(overkill_C),
  n_exact_modes = if (error_method == "compressed")
    sum(coeff_U_0 != 0 | coeff_FF != 0) else NULL,
  n_reference_samples = ceiling(T_final / overkill_time_step),
  n_blocks = unique(c(error_n_blocks, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000)),
  n_solver_steps = time_grid$N
)
print(error_memory, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
# Set error_n_blocks above to the desired count before running the experiment.

# Build a reference grid ending at the same final time as the solver grid.
reference_grid <- make_time_grid(T_final = T_final, target_step = overkill_time_step)
overkill_time_step <- reference_grid$time_step
overkill_time_seq <- reference_grid$time_seq


# Spatial eigenfunctions and unfractionalized eigenvalues do not depend on alpha.
reference_eigen_params <- gets.eigen.params(
  N_finite = N_finite, kappa = kappa,
  alpha = alpha_vector[1], graph = overkill_graph
)
reference_eigenvalues <- reference_eigen_params$EIGENVAL
auxE <- reference_eigen_params$EIGENFUN
active_modes <- which(coeff_U_0 != 0 | coeff_FF != 0)
exact_basis <- auxE[, active_modes, drop = FALSE]
exact_initial <- coeff_U_0[active_modes]
exact_forcing <- coeff_FF[active_modes]
m_values <- c()

errors_projected <- matrix(NA_real_, length(h_vector), length(alpha_vector))
for (i in seq_along(h_vector)) {
  h <- h_vector[i]
  graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = h)
  graph$compute_fem()
  C <- graph$mesh$C
  L <- kappa^2 * C + graph$mesh$G
  Psi <- graph$fem_basis(overkill_graph$get_mesh_locations())
  U_0 <- project_u0_tadpole(graph, amplitude = coeff_U_0[5])
  spatial_load <- coeff_FF[7] * assemble_e7_load_tadpole(graph)
  error_projection <- if (error_method == "compressed")
    prepare_reference_error(Psi, overkill_C, exact_basis) else NULL

  cases <- run_reference_cases(seq_along(alpha_vector), function(j) {
    alpha <- alpha_vector[j]
    beta <- alpha / 2
    exact_rates <- diffusion * reference_eigenvalues[active_modes]^beta
    coefficients_at_time <- function(t) exact_modal_coefficients(
      t, exact_rates, exact_initial, exact_forcing, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA)
    exact_at_time <- function(t) exact_basis %*% coefficients_at_time(t)
    my_op_frac <- my.fractional.operators.frac(
      L = L, beta = beta, C = C, scale.factor = kappa^2,
      m = m_fixed, time_step = time_step, diffusion = diffusion)
    solve_fractional_evolution_error(
      my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, U_0, spatial_load, g_average,
      Psi, overkill_C, overkill_time_seq, exact_at_time,
      n_blocks = error_n_blocks, verbose = error_verbose,
      error_method = error_method, coefficients_at_time = coefficients_at_time,
      error_projection = error_projection)
  }, workers = workers)
  errors_projected[i, ] <- vapply(cases, identity, numeric(1))

}
attr(errors_projected,"coefficient_source") <- "rSPDE BRASIL"
  attr(errors_projected,"parameters") <- list(study="h",axis=h_vector,alpha=alpha_vector,
    m=m_fixed,diffusion=diffusion,kappa=kappa,T=T_final,reference_h=overkill_h,
    reference_tau=overkill_time_step,fixed=list(tau=time_step))
  save(errors_projected,file=output_file)
  save_smooth_figure(errors_projected,h_vector,alpha_vector,"h")
  invisible(errors_projected)
}

run_smooth_tau <- function(workers=1L,output_file="data_files/errors_projected_tau_mat.RData") {
# Parameters
T_final <- 1
diffusion <- 1e-3 # nu > 0 in u_t + nu * L^(alpha/2) u = f
workers <- workers
error_method <- "compressed" # "reference" retains the original error accumulator
kappa <- 4
N_finite <- 4 # choose even
adjusted_N_finite <- N_finite + N_finite/2 + 1
# Coefficients for u_0 and f
coeff_U_0 <- 50*(1:adjusted_N_finite)^-1
coeff_U_0[-5] <- 0
coeff_FF <- rep(0, adjusted_N_finite)
coeff_FF[7] <- 10
# The analytic forcing load currently supports only the seventh eigenfunction.
stopifnot(length(coeff_FF) >= 7L, all(coeff_FF[-7] == 0))

AAA = 1
OMEGA = pi

# Requested time steps and fixed spatial mesh size.
tau_targets <- T_final / c(200L, 80L, 32L, 13L, 6L, 2L)
h_fixed <- 1e-3
m_fixed <- 8
alpha_vector <- seq(0.5, 1.9, 0.2)

# Use the actual uniform steps in both the solver and the convergence fit.
time_grids <- lapply(tau_targets, function(target) {
  make_time_grid(T_final = T_final, target_step = target)
})
tau_vector <- vapply(time_grids, function(grid) grid$time_step, numeric(1))
stopifnot(length(unique(tau_vector)) == length(tau_vector))

# Interval averages depend only on the time grid; reuse them for every alpha.
g_averages <- lapply(time_grids, function(grid) {
  average_sine_forcing(grid$time_seq, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA)
})

# Reference quadrature and error accumulation.
overkill_time_step <- 1e-5
overkill_h <- 1e-5
error_verbose <- FALSE
error_n_blocks <- 1L
# Heavy setup and convergence computation: run manually to replace saved results.
overkill_graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = overkill_h)
overkill_graph$compute_fem()
overkill_C <- overkill_graph$mesh$C

# Preview modeled memory before allocating the reference time vector or solving.
# estimated_gib excludes FEM/solver objects and other session memory by default.
error_memory <- estimate_error_memory(
  n_reference_nodes = nrow(overkill_C),
  n_exact_modes = if (error_method == "compressed")
    sum(coeff_U_0 != 0 | coeff_FF != 0) else NULL,
  n_reference_samples = ceiling(T_final / overkill_time_step),
  n_blocks = unique(c(error_n_blocks, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000)),
  n_solver_steps = vapply(time_grids, function(grid) grid$N, numeric(1))
)
print(error_memory, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
# Set error_n_blocks above to the desired count before running the experiment.

reference_grid <- make_time_grid(
  T_final = T_final, target_step = overkill_time_step
)
overkill_time_step <- reference_grid$time_step
overkill_time_seq <- reference_grid$time_seq

# The spatial discretization is fixed for every time step and alpha.
graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = h_fixed)
graph$compute_fem()
C <- graph$mesh$C
L <- kappa^2 * C + graph$mesh$G
Psi <- graph$fem_basis(overkill_graph$get_mesh_locations())
stopifnot(all(coeff_U_0[-5] == 0))
U_0 <- project_u0_tadpole(graph, amplitude = coeff_U_0[5])

# Reference spatial modes and loads are independent of alpha, tau, and m.
reference_eigen_params <- gets.eigen.params(
  N_finite = N_finite, kappa = kappa,
  alpha = alpha_vector[1], graph = overkill_graph
)
reference_eigenvalues <- reference_eigen_params$EIGENVAL
overkill_EIGENFUN <- reference_eigen_params$EIGENFUN
active_modes <- which(coeff_U_0 != 0 | coeff_FF != 0)
exact_basis <- overkill_EIGENFUN[, active_modes, drop = FALSE]
exact_initial <- coeff_U_0[active_modes]
exact_forcing <- coeff_FF[active_modes]
spatial_load <- coeff_FF[7] * assemble_e7_load_tadpole(graph)
error_projection <- if (error_method == "compressed")
  prepare_reference_error(Psi, overkill_C, exact_basis) else NULL
m_values <- c()

errors_projected <- matrix(NA_real_, length(tau_vector), length(alpha_vector))
for (j in seq_along(alpha_vector)) {
  alpha <- alpha_vector[j]
  beta <- alpha / 2
  exact_rates <- diffusion * reference_eigenvalues[active_modes]^beta
  coefficients_at_time <- function(t) exact_modal_coefficients(
    t, exact_rates, exact_initial, exact_forcing, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA)
  exact_at_time <- function(t) exact_basis %*% coefficients_at_time(t)

  cases <- run_reference_cases(seq_along(tau_vector), function(i) {
    time_grid <- time_grids[[i]]
    time_step <- time_grid$time_step
    time_seq <- time_grid$time_seq
    g_average <- g_averages[[i]]
    m <- m_fixed
    my_op_frac <- my.fractional.operators.frac(
      L = L, beta = beta, C = C, scale.factor = kappa^2,
      m = m, time_step = time_step, diffusion = diffusion)
    solve_fractional_evolution_error(
      my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, U_0, spatial_load, g_average,
      Psi, overkill_C, overkill_time_seq, exact_at_time,
      n_blocks = error_n_blocks, verbose = error_verbose,
      error_method = error_method, coefficients_at_time = coefficients_at_time,
      error_projection = error_projection)
  }, workers = workers)
  errors_projected[, j] <- vapply(cases, identity, numeric(1))

}
attr(errors_projected,"coefficient_source") <- "rSPDE BRASIL"
  attr(errors_projected,"parameters") <- list(study="tau",axis=tau_vector,alpha=alpha_vector,
    m=m_fixed,diffusion=diffusion,kappa=kappa,T=T_final,reference_h=overkill_h,
    reference_tau=overkill_time_step,fixed=list(h=h_fixed))
  save(errors_projected,file=output_file)
  save_smooth_figure(errors_projected,tau_vector,alpha_vector,"tau")
  invisible(errors_projected)
}

isolated_discrete_spectrum <- function(C, L, max_dimension = 1200L, max_dense_mib = 1024, residual_tolerance = 1e-08,
    orthogonality_tolerance = 1e-10) {
    n <- nrow(C)
    stopifnot(n >= 1L, ncol(C) == n, identical(dim(L), dim(C)), Matrix::isSymmetric(C, tol = 1e-12), Matrix::isSymmetric(L, tol = 1e-12),
        length(max_dimension) == 1L, is.finite(max_dimension), max_dimension >= 1, length(max_dense_mib) == 1L,
        is.finite(max_dense_mib), max_dense_mib > 0, is.finite(residual_tolerance), residual_tolerance > 0, is.finite(orthogonality_tolerance),
        orthogonality_tolerance > 0)
    estimated_mib <- 20 * 8 * as.double(n)^2/1024^2
    if (n > max_dimension || estimated_mib > max_dense_mib)
        stop("Complete eigendecomposition refused before dense allocation: dimension ", n, ", estimated temporary storage ",
            round(estimated_mib, 1), " MiB. Choose a moderate isolated-study mesh or explicitly raise the guards.")
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    dense_C <- as.matrix(C)
    dense_L <- as.matrix(L)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(dense_C)), all(is.finite(dense_L)))
    R <- chol(dense_C)
    Rinv <- backsolve(R, diag(n))
    symmetric <- Matrix::crossprod(Rinv, dense_L %*% Rinv)
    ee <- eigen((symmetric + t(symmetric))/2, symmetric = TRUE)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(ee$values)), all(ee$values > 0))
    V <- backsolve(R, ee$vectors)
    CV <- C %*% V
    LV <- L %*% V
    residual <- as.matrix(LV - sweep(as.matrix(CV), 2L, ee$values, `*`))
    denominator <- sqrt(colSums(as.matrix(LV)^2)) + abs(ee$values) * sqrt(colSums(as.matrix(CV)^2))
    residual_error <- max(sqrt(colSums(residual^2))/pmax(denominator, .Machine$double.xmin))
    orthogonality_error <- max(abs(Matrix::crossprod(V, CV) - diag(n)))
    if (residual_error > residual_tolerance || orthogonality_error > orthogonality_tolerance)
        stop("Numerical eigensystem failed validation: residual = ", residual_error, ", C-orthogonality = ", orthogonality_error)
    list(values = ee$values, vectors = V, diagnostics = data.frame(dimension = n, eigenvalue_min = min(ee$values),
        eigenvalue_max = max(ee$values), relative_residual = residual_error, C_orthogonality_error = orthogonality_error,
        estimated_dense_mib = estimated_mib, elapsed_seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started))
}

isolated_exact_be_reference <- function(C, spectrum, initial, spatial_load, time_seq, alpha, diffusion = 1, A = 1,
    omega = pi, max_history_mib = 256) {
    n <- nrow(C)
    stopifnot(length(initial) == n, length(spatial_load) == n, all(is.finite(initial)), all(is.finite(spatial_load)),
        length(time_seq) >= 2L, all(is.finite(time_seq)), all(diff(time_seq) > 0), length(alpha) == 1L, is.finite(alpha),
        alpha > 0, alpha <= 2, length(diffusion) == 1L, is.finite(diffusion), diffusion > 0, length(A) == 1L, is.finite(A),
        length(omega) == 1L, is.finite(omega), is.finite(max_history_mib), max_history_mib > 0, identical(dim(spectrum$vectors),
            c(n, n)), length(spectrum$values) == n)
    dt <- diff(time_seq)[1L]
    stopifnot(max(abs(diff(time_seq) - dt)) <= 128 * .Machine$double.eps * max(1, abs(tail(time_seq, 1L))))
    history_mib <- 2 * 8 * as.double(n) * length(time_seq)/1024^2
    if (history_mib > max_history_mib)
        stop("Exact reference history exceeds max_history_mib; use a moderate time grid.")
    V <- spectrum$vectors
    x <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V, C %*% initial))
    f <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(V, spatial_load))
    rates <- diffusion * spectrum$values^(alpha/2)
    mu <- 1/(1 + dt * rates)
    g <- average_sine_forcing(time_seq, A = A, omega = omega)
    states <- coefficients <- matrix(0, n, length(time_seq))
    states[, 1L] <- initial
    coefficients[, 1L] <- x
    y <- x
    for (k in seq_len(length(time_seq) - 1L)) {
        y <- mu * (y + dt * f * g[k + 1L])
        coefficients[, k + 1L] <- y
        states[, k + 1L] <- as.numeric(V %*% y)
    }
    list(states = states, coefficients = coefficients, initial_coefficients = x, forcing_coefficients = f, exact_rates = rates,
        g_average = g, dt = dt, time_seq = time_seq, alpha = alpha, diffusion = diffusion, history_mib = history_mib)
}

isolated_tadpole_data <- function(h, kappa = 4, initial_amplitude = 10, forcing_amplitude = 10) {
    stopifnot(length(h) == 1L, is.finite(h), h > 0, length(kappa) == 1L, is.finite(kappa), kappa > 0, is.finite(initial_amplitude),
        is.finite(forcing_amplitude))
    graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h)
    graph$compute_fem()
    C <- graph$mesh$C
    L <- kappa^2 * C + graph$mesh$G
    PtE <- graph$mesh$PtE
    lengths <- graph$get_edge_lengths()
    stopifnot(length(lengths) == 2L, max(abs(lengths - c(1, 2))) < 1e-12, nrow(C) == 2L + nrow(PtE))
    load <- numeric(nrow(C))
    element_lengths <- numeric()
    for (edge in 1:2) {
        idx <- which(PtE[, 1L] == edge)
        idx <- idx[order(PtE[idx, 2L])]
        coordinates <- c(0, lengths[edge] * PtE[idx, 2L], lengths[edge])
        nodes <- c(if (edge == 1L) 1L else 2L, 2L + idx, 2L)
        element_lengths <- c(element_lengths, diff(coordinates))
        for (i in seq_len(length(coordinates) - 1L)) {
            pair <- trig_hat_integrals(coordinates[i], coordinates[i + 1L], 2 * pi, A = forcing_amplitude * sqrt(2/3))
            load[nodes[i]] <- load[nodes[i]] + pair[1L]
            load[nodes[i + 1L]] <- load[nodes[i + 1L]] + pair[2L]
        }
    }
    list(C = C, L = L, initial = project_u0_tadpole(graph, initial_amplitude), spatial_load = load, kappa = kappa,
        h_requested = h, h_min = min(element_lengths), h_max = max(element_lengths))
}

isolated_rational_rates <- function(eigenvalues, alpha, m, kappa, diffusion=1, coefficients=NULL) {
  if(alpha==2) return(diffusion*eigenvalues)
  if(is.null(coefficients)) coefficients <- brasil_coefficients(m,alpha/2)
  diffusion*kappa^alpha/brasil_inverse(eigenvalues/kappa^2,coefficients)
}

isolated_beta_bracket <- function(m,beta) {
  table <- get(paste0("m_brasil",m,"t"),asNamespace("rSPDE"))
  grid <- table$alpha; tolerance <- 32*.Machine$double.eps*max(1,abs(beta))
  list(exact=any(abs(grid-beta)<=tolerance),lower=max(grid[grid<=beta+tolerance]),
       upper=min(grid[grid>=beta-tolerance]))
}


isolated_rational_error <- function(data,spectrum,reference,m,excitation_tolerance=1e-8) {
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    stopifnot(nrow(reference$states) == nrow(data$C), ncol(reference$states) == length(reference$time_seq))
    coefficients <- if(reference$alpha==2) NULL else brasil_coefficients(m,reference$alpha/2)
    op <- my.fractional.operators.frac(data$L,reference$alpha/2,data$C,data$kappa^2,
      m,reference$dt,reference$diffusion)
    rates <- isolated_rational_rates(spectrum$values,reference$alpha,m,data$kappa,
      reference$diffusion,coefficients)
    mu <- 1/(1 + reference$dt * rates)
    y <- reference$initial_coefficients
    u <- as.numeric(data$initial)
    total <- spectral_total <- compensation <- spectral_compensation <- 0
    for (k in seq_len(length(reference$time_seq) - 1L)) {
        forcing <- reference$g_average[k + 1L]
        rhs <- data$C %*% u + reference$dt * data$spatial_load * forcing
        u <- as.numeric(my.solver.frac(op, rhs))
        delta <- reference$states[, k + 1L] - u
        value <- reference$dt * sum(delta * (data$C %*% delta))
        adjusted <- value - compensation
        updated <- total + adjusted
        compensation <- (updated - total) - adjusted
        total <- updated
        y <- mu * (y + reference$dt * reference$forcing_coefficients * forcing)
        dy <- reference$coefficients[, k + 1L] - y
        value <- reference$dt * sum(dy^2)
        adjusted <- value - spectral_compensation
        updated <- spectral_total + adjusted
        spectral_compensation <- (updated - spectral_total) - adjusted
        spectral_total <- updated
    }
    sparse_error <- sqrt(max(0, total))
    product_error <- sqrt(max(0, spectral_total))
    gap <- u - as.numeric(spectrum$vectors %*% y)
    final_gap <- sqrt(max(0, sum(gap * (data$C %*% gap))))
    excited <- abs(reference$initial_coefficients) > excitation_tolerance * max(abs(reference$initial_coefficients)) |
        abs(reference$forcing_coefficients) > excitation_tolerance * max(abs(reference$forcing_coefficients))
    relative_rate_error <- rates/reference$exact_rates - 1
    bracket <- if (reference$alpha == 2)
        list(exact = TRUE, lower = 1, upper = 1)
    else isolated_beta_bracket(m,reference$alpha/2)
    data.frame(alpha = reference$alpha, diffusion = reference$diffusion, m = m, error = sparse_error, product_error = product_error,
        absolute_error_disagreement = abs(sparse_error - product_error), relative_error_disagreement = abs(sparse_error -
            product_error)/max(product_error, .Machine$double.xmin), final_state_gap_C = final_gap, max_relative_rate_error_full = max(abs(relative_rate_error)),
        max_relative_rate_error_excited = if (any(excited))
            max(abs(relative_rate_error[excited]))
        else 0, excited_numerical_modes = sum(excited), coefficient_source = "brasil", coefficient_beta_exact = bracket$exact,
        beta_exact_in_package_table = bracket$exact, beta_table_lower = bracket$lower, beta_table_upper = bracket$upper, elapsed_seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] -
            started)
}

isolated_parameters <- function() list(h=0.02,tau=0.005,m_max=14L,
  alpha_vector=seq(0.5,1.9,0.2),T_final=1,kappa=4,diffusion=1)

run_isolated_brasil <- function(output_file="data_files/isolated_m_results.rds") {
  library(ggplot2)
h <- 0.02
tau <- 0.005
m_max <- 14L
coefficient_source <- "brasil"  # rSPDE m_brasil<m>t tables; keep their constant term

alpha_vector <- seq(0.5, 1.9, 0.2)
T_final <- 1
kappa <- 4
diffusion <- 1
stopifnot(length(h) == 1L, is.finite(h), h > 0,
          length(tau) == 1L, is.finite(tau), tau > 0,
          length(T_final) == 1L, is.finite(T_final), T_final > 0,
          length(kappa) == 1L, is.finite(kappa), kappa > 0,
          length(diffusion) == 1L, is.finite(diffusion), diffusion > 0,
          length(m_max) == 1L, is.finite(m_max), m_max >= 2,
          m_max == floor(m_max), m_max <= max(brasil_supported_orders()),
          length(alpha_vector) > 0, !anyDuplicated(alpha_vector),
          all(is.finite(alpha_vector)), all(alpha_vector >= 0.5 & alpha_vector <= 2))
m_vector <- seq_len(m_max)
# Reject unsupported coefficients before assembling the eigensystem.
for (alpha in alpha_vector[alpha_vector != 2])
  for (m in m_vector) brasil_coefficients(m, alpha/2)

# Keep the requested tau exactly; require an integer number of steps.
N <- round(T_final / tau)
if (!is.finite(N) || N < 1 || N > 1e6 ||
    abs(T_final / tau - N) > 64 * .Machine$double.eps * max(1, N))

      10^(-(5 + reciprocal_m) / 2) else 1e-3
    reciprocal_z <- exp(seq(0, log(1 / reciprocal_delta), length.out = 20001L))
    reciprocal_x <- 1 / reciprocal_z
    reciprocal_roots <- brasil_coefficients(reciprocal_m, reciprocal_beta)

                                   reciprocal_z^(-reciprocal_beta))

                                  reciprocal_x^reciprocal_beta)
    reciprocal_gap <- max(abs(reciprocal_large_error - reciprocal_unit_error))
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(reciprocal_large_error, reciprocal_unit_error))),
              reciprocal_gap <= 1e-12)
    reciprocal_rows[[length(reciprocal_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      alpha = reciprocal_alpha, m = reciprocal_m, delta = reciprocal_delta,
      large_interval_error = max(reciprocal_large_error),
      reciprocal_interval_error = max(reciprocal_unit_error),
```
