```{r brasil-functions-4, eval=TRUE}
rough_mesh <- function(J, kappa = 4) {
    stopifnot(length(J) == 1L, is.finite(J), J == as.integer(J), J >= 2L, J <= 20L, length(kappa) == 1L, is.finite(kappa),
        kappa > 0)
    theta <- seq(-pi, pi, length.out = 129L)
    edges <- list(rbind(c(0, 0), c(1, 0)), cbind(1 + 1/pi + cos(theta)/pi, sin(theta)/pi))
    constructor <- MetricGraph::metric_graph$public_methods$initialize
    if ("edges" %in% names(formals(constructor))) {
        graph <- MetricGraph::metric_graph$new(edges = edges, verbose = 0)
        graph$set_manual_edge_lengths(edge_lengths = c(1, 2))
    }
    else {
        lines <- sp::SpatialLines(lapply(seq_along(edges), function(i) sp::Lines(list(sp::Line(edges[[i]])), ID = as.character(i))))
        graph <- MetricGraph::metric_graph$new(lines = lines, remove_circles = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
        graph$edge_lengths <- c(1, 2)
    }
    h <- 2^-J
    graph$build_mesh(h = h)
    graph$compute_fem()
    C <- graph$mesh$C
    K <- kappa^2 * C + graph$mesh$G
    PtE <- graph$mesh$PtE
    stopifnot(nrow(C) == 3L * 2^J, max(abs(graph$mesh$h_e - h)) < 1e-13)
    loop <- which(PtE[, 1L] == 2L)
    loop <- loop[order(PtE[loop, 2L])]
    loop_nodes <- c(2L, 2L + loop, 2L)
    x <- seq(0, 2, by = h)
    stopifnot(length(loop_nodes) == length(x))
    j <- seq_len(J - 1L)
    theta_j <- pi * 2^j * h
    B <- matrix(0, nrow(C), length(j))
    B[2L + loop, ] <- outer(2 * PtE[loop, 2L], 2^j, function(x, k) sinpi(x * k)) * rep(h * (sin(theta_j/2)/(theta_j/2))^2,
        each = length(loop))
    load <- as.numeric(B %*% (1/j))
    list(J = J, h = h, C = C, K = K, graph = graph, B = B, load = load, j = j, loop_nodes = loop_nodes, loop_x = x,
        kappa = kappa)
}

rough_projection <- function(mesh, quadrature_order = 16L) {
    stopifnot(quadrature_order >= 8L, quadrature_order == as.integer(quadrature_order))
    Cfactor <- Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(mesh$C), LDL = FALSE)
    P <- as.matrix(Matrix::solve(Cfactor, mesh$B, system = "A"))
    rule <- statmod::gauss.quad(quadrature_order, kind = "legendre")
    z <- (rule$nodes + 1)/2
    weights <- rule$weights/2
    nodes <- mesh$loop_nodes
    left <- head(nodes, -1L)
    right <- tail(nodes, -1L)
    R <- matrix(0, length(mesh$j), length(mesh$j))
    for (q in seq_along(z)) {
        x <- head(mesh$loop_x, -1L) + mesh$h * z[q]
        exact <- outer(x, 2^mesh$j, function(x, k) sinpi(x * k))
        residual <- exact - ((1 - z[q]) * P[left, , drop = FALSE] + z[q] * P[right, , drop = FALSE])
        R <- R + mesh$h * weights[q] * Matrix::crossprod(residual)
    }
    stem <- c(1L, 2L + which(mesh$graph$mesh$PtE[, 1L] == 1L), 2L)
    for (q in seq_along(z)) {
        residual <- (1 - z[q]) * P[head(stem, -1L), , drop = FALSE] + z[q] * P[tail(stem, -1L), , drop = FALSE]
        R <- R + mesh$h * weights[q] * Matrix::crossprod(residual)
    }
    list(P = P, residual_gram = R)
}

rough_rates <- function(j, alpha, diffusion = 1, kappa = 4) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(j)), all(j >= 1), all(j == floor(j)), length(alpha) == 1L, is.finite(alpha), alpha >
        0, alpha < 2, length(diffusion) == 1L, is.finite(diffusion), diffusion > 0, length(kappa) == 1L, is.finite(kappa),
        kappa > 0)
    diffusion * (kappa^2 + pi^2 * 2^(2 * j))^(alpha/2)
}

rough_response_integral <- function(a, T_final = 1) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(a)), all(a > 0), T_final > 0, is.finite(T_final))
    z <- a * T_final
    answer <- T_final * (1 + 2 * expm1(-z)/z - expm1(-2 * z)/(2 * z))
    small <- z < 0.1
    if (any(small)) {
        zz <- z[small]
        value <- rep(0, length(zz))
        for (n in 2:18) value <- value + (-1)^n * (2^n - 2) * zz^n/factorial(n + 1)
        answer[small] <- T_final * value
    }
    answer
}

rough_tail <- function(J, alpha, diffusion = 1, kappa = 4, T_final = 1, relative_tolerance = 1e-13) {
    stopifnot(J >= 1L, J == as.integer(J), relative_tolerance > 0, relative_tolerance < 1)
    total <- 0
    for (j in J:450L) {
        a <- rough_rates(j, alpha, diffusion, kappa)
        term <- rough_response_integral(a, T_final)/(j * a)^2
        total <- total + term
        next_j <- j + 1L
        bound <- T_final/(diffusion^2 * pi^(2 * alpha)) * 2^(-2 * alpha * next_j)/next_j^2/(1 - 2^(-2 * alpha))
        if (bound <= relative_tolerance * total)
            return(list(squared = total, omitted_squared_bound = bound, last_j = j))
    }
    stop("Infinite forcing tail did not meet its requested tolerance.")
}

rough_rational_coefficients <- function(beta, order = 16L) {
    stopifnot(beta > 0, beta < 1, order %in% 1:20)
    table <- get(paste0("m_brasil", order, "t"), envir = asNamespace("rSPDE"))
    row <- which(abs(table$alpha - beta) < 32 * .Machine$double.eps)
    if (length(row) != 1L)
        stop("No exact BRASIL coefficient row at beta = ", beta)
    poles <- as.numeric(table[row, paste0("p", seq_len(order))])
    residues <- as.numeric(table[row, paste0("r", seq_len(order))])
    constant <- table$k[row]
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(poles, residues, constant))), all(poles < 0), all(residues > 0), constant >= 0)
    index <- order(poles)
    list(poles = poles[index], residues = residues[index], constant = constant, order = as.integer(order), beta = beta)
}

rough_transfer <- function(coefficients, tau, diffusion = 1, kappa = 4) {
    p <- coefficients$poles
    r <- coefficients$residues
    strength <- tau * diffusion * kappa^(2 * coefficients$beta)
    stopifnot(is.finite(strength), strength > 0)
    constant <- coefficients$constant
    poles <- numeric(length(p))
    for (i in seq_along(p)) {
        upper <- p[i]
        lower <- if (i == 1L)
            2 * upper
        else p[i - 1L]
        f <- function(x) constant + strength + sum(r/(x - p))
        if (i == 1L)
            while (f(lower) <= 0) lower <- 2 * lower
        width <- upper - lower
        normalized <- function(z) {
            if (z == 0 && i > 1L)
                return(.Machine$double.xmax)
            if (z == 1)
                return(-.Machine$double.xmax)
            f(lower + width * z)
        }
        root <- stats::uniroot(normalized, c(0, 1), tol = 2 * .Machine$double.eps, maxiter = 1000L)$root
        poles[i] <- lower + width * root
    }
    residues <- vapply(poles, function(z) strength/sum(r/(z - p)^2), numeric(1))
    remainder <- constant/(constant + strength)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(c(poles, residues, remainder))), all(poles < 0), all(residues > 0), remainder >= 0,
        remainder < 1)
    x <- 10^seq(0, 10, length.out = 257L)
    inverse <- vapply(x, function(z) constant + sum(r/(z - p)), numeric(1))
    expected <- inverse/(inverse + strength)
    actual <- remainder + vapply(x, function(z) sum(residues/(z - poles)), numeric(1))
    reconstruction_error <- max(abs(actual - expected))
    if (reconstruction_error > 2e-12)
        stop("Inaccurate partial fractions: ", format(reconstruction_error, digits = 5))
    list(poles = poles, residues = residues, remainder = remainder, reconstruction_error = reconstruction_error,
        coefficients = coefficients)
}

rough_operator <- function(mesh, alpha, tau, order = 16L, diffusion = 1) {
    transfer <- rough_transfer(rough_rational_coefficients(alpha/2, order), tau, diffusion, mesh$kappa)
    A <- lapply(transfer$poles, function(p) mesh$K/mesh$kappa^2 - p * mesh$C)
    list(C = mesh$C, partial_fraction_terms = A, factorizations = lapply(A, function(A) Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(A),
        LDL = FALSE)), mass_factor = Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(mesh$C), LDL = FALSE), beta = alpha/2,
        m = order, residues = transfer$residues, remainder = transfer$remainder, transfer = transfer,
        order = order)
}

rough_matrix_step <- function(operator, rhs) {
    output <- operator$remainder * as.numeric(Matrix::solve(operator$mass_factor, rhs, system = "A"))
    for (i in seq_along(operator$residues)) output <- output + operator$residues[i] * as.numeric(Matrix::solve(operator$factorizations[[i]],
        rhs, system = "A"))
    output
}

rough_symmetry_embedding <- function(mesh) {
    n <- as.integer(1/mesh$h)
    quarter <- n/2L
    r <- seq_len(quarter - 1L)
    rows <- mesh$loop_nodes[1L + c(r, n - r, n + r, 2L * n - r)]
    Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = rows, j = rep(r, 4L), x = rep(c(1, -1, 1, -1), each = length(r)), dims = c(nrow(mesh$C),
        length(r)))
}

rough_solve <- function(mesh, alpha, time_step, order = 16L, diffusion = 1, T_final = 1, projection = rough_projection(mesh),
    tail_tolerance = 1e-13, return_states = FALSE, symmetry_reduction = TRUE) {
    stopifnot(is.finite(time_step), time_step > 0, T_final > 0)
    N <- ceiling(T_final/time_step)
    tau <- T_final/N
    solver_mesh <- mesh
    solver_projection <- projection$P
    embedding <- NULL
    if (symmetry_reduction) {
        embedding <- rough_symmetry_embedding(mesh)
        solver_mesh$C <- Matrix::crossprod(embedding, mesh$C %*% embedding)
        solver_mesh$K <- Matrix::crossprod(embedding, mesh$K %*% embedding)
        solver_mesh$load <- as.numeric(Matrix::crossprod(embedding, mesh$load))
        factor <- Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(solver_mesh$C), LDL = FALSE)
        solver_projection <- as.matrix(Matrix::solve(factor, Matrix::crossprod(embedding, mesh$B), system = "A"))
        if (max(abs(embedding %*% solver_projection - projection$P)) > 1e-11)
            stop("The continuum projections do not lie in the selected symmetry subspace.")
    }
    operator <- rough_operator(solver_mesh, alpha, tau, order, diffusion)
    tail <- rough_tail(mesh$J, alpha, diffusion, mesh$kappa, T_final, tail_tolerance)
    general <- function(A) as(as(A, "generalMatrix"), "CsparseMatrix")
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    result <- rough_matrix_evolve_cpp(general(solver_mesh$C), lapply(operator$partial_fraction_terms, general),
        operator$residues, operator$remainder, solver_mesh$load, solver_projection, projection$residual_gram, rough_rates(mesh$j,
            alpha, diffusion, mesh$kappa), mesh$j, tau, N, tail$squared, return_states)
    result$elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
    result$n_solver_nodes <- nrow(solver_mesh$C)
    if (!is.null(embedding)) {
        result$final_state <- as.numeric(embedding %*% result$final_state)
        if (return_states)
            result$states <- as.matrix(embedding %*% result$states)
    }
    result$tau <- tau
    result$N <- N
    result$order <- order
    result$tail <- tail
    result$transfer_reconstruction_error <- operator$transfer$reconstruction_error
    result
}

rough_parameters <- function() {
    list(J = 5:9, alpha = seq(0.5, 1.9, 0.2), time_steps = c(5e-04, 0.000125, 1/30000, 1e-05, 1/320000, 1e-06,
        4e-07, 2e-07), rational_order = 14L, symmetry_reduction = TRUE, T_final = 1, diffusion = 1, kappa = 4,
        projection_quadrature = 16L, tail_tolerance = 1e-13, fit_J = 7:9, forcing = "sum_{j>=1} sin(2^j*pi*x)/j on loop; zero on stem",
        reconstruction = "right-constant backward Euler", error_integration = "analytic time moments, spatial projection residual, bounded infinite tail")
}

rough_run_experiment <- function(parameters = rough_parameters(), output_file = file.path("data_files", "rough_h_results.rds"),
    checkpoint_dir = tempfile("rough-checkpoints-"), workers = 1L, root = getwd(), cache_dir = tempdir()) {
    stopifnot(length(parameters$alpha) == length(parameters$time_steps), all(parameters$fit_J %in% parameters$J),
        workers >= 1L, workers == as.integer(workers))
    dir.create(checkpoint_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    rough_compile_solver(root, cache_dir)
    cases <- expand.grid(J = parameters$J, alpha_index = seq_along(parameters$alpha))
    identity <- list(parameters=parameters,sources=tools::md5sum(file.path(root,"brasilfunc.Rmd")))
    run_case <- function(i) {
        J <- cases$J[i]
        a <- cases$alpha_index[i]
        alpha <- parameters$alpha[a]
        checkpoint <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, sprintf("J%02d-alpha%03d.rds", J, round(100 * alpha)))
        if (file.exists(checkpoint)) {
            saved <- readRDS(checkpoint)
            if (!identical(saved$identity, identity))
                stop("Checkpoint source/settings mismatch: ", checkpoint)
            return(saved$value)
        }
        message(sprintf("Matrix experiment: J=%s, h=%g, alpha=%g", J, 2^-J, alpha))
        mesh <- rough_mesh(J, parameters$kappa)
        projection <- rough_projection(mesh, parameters$projection_quadrature)
        value <- rough_solve(mesh, alpha, parameters$time_steps[a], order = parameters$rational_order, diffusion = parameters$diffusion,
            T_final = parameters$T_final, projection = projection, tail_tolerance = parameters$tail_tolerance,
            symmetry_reduction = parameters$symmetry_reduction)
        value$final_state <- value$states <- NULL
        value$J <- J
        value$alpha <- alpha
        value$n_nodes <- nrow(mesh$C)
        saveRDS(list(identity = identity, value = value), checkpoint)
        message(sprintf("Finished J=%s alpha=%g: E=%.9g (%.2f s)", J, alpha, value$error, value$elapsed))
        value
    }
    safe_case <- function(i) tryCatch(run_case(i), error = function(e) list(failed = TRUE, message = conditionMessage(e),
        case = i))
    values <- if (workers > 1L && .Platform$OS.type == "unix")
        parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(cases)), safe_case, mc.cores = min(workers, nrow(cases)), mc.preschedule = FALSE)
    else lapply(seq_len(nrow(cases)), safe_case)
    failed <- vapply(values, function(x) !is.list(x) || isTRUE(x$failed), logical(1))
    if (any(failed))
        stop("Rough experiment failed: ", paste(vapply(values[failed], function(x) if (is.list(x))
            x$message
        else as.character(x), character(1)), collapse = "; "))
    errors <- matrix(vapply(values, `[[`, numeric(1), "error"), nrow = length(parameters$J), ncol = length(parameters$alpha))
    corrected <- errors * parameters$J
    fit <- which(parameters$J %in% parameters$fit_J)
    slope <- function(y) unname(coef(stats::lm(log10(y[fit]) ~ log10(2^-parameters$J[fit])))[2L])
    rates <- data.frame(alpha = parameters$alpha, theoretical = parameters$alpha, raw = apply(errors, 2L, slope),
        corrected = apply(corrected, 2L, slope))
    rates$relative_error_percent <- 100 * abs(rates$corrected - rates$alpha)/rates$alpha
    result <- list(parameters = parameters, errors = errors, corrected_errors = corrected, rates = rates, cases = values,
        provenance = identity, generated_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z", tz = "Asia/Riyadh"), session_info = utils::sessionInfo())
    saveRDS(result, output_file)
    result
}

rough_convergence_plot <- function(result, corrected = FALSE) {
    p <- result$parameters
    errors <- if (corrected)
        result$corrected_errors
    else result$errors
    frame <- expand.grid(J = p$J, column = seq_along(p$alpha))
    frame$h <- 2^-frame$J
    frame$error <- as.vector(errors)
    frame$alpha <- factor(p$alpha[frame$column], levels = p$alpha)
    fit <- which(p$J %in% p$fit_J)
    guide <- frame
    for (a in seq_along(p$alpha)) {
        target <- guide$column == a
        model <- (2^-p$J)^p$alpha[a]
        if (!corrected)
            model <- model/p$J
        constant <- exp(mean(log(errors[fit, a]/model[fit])))
        guide$error[target] <- constant * model
    }
    label <- if (corrected)
        expression(J %.% E[h])
    else expression(E[h])
    ggplot2::ggplot(frame, ggplot2::aes(h, error, color = alpha, group = alpha)) + ggplot2::geom_line(data = guide,
        linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.8) + ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = 2^-p$J, labels = function(x) paste0("1/", round(1/x))) + ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
        ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0.05, end = 0.85) + ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2L,
        byrow = TRUE)) + ggplot2::labs(x = expression(h ~ "(log scale)"), y = label, color = expression(alpha),
        title = if (corrected)
            "Spatial convergence after logarithmic correction"
        else "Spatial convergence with rough forcing") + ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))
}

rough_save_figures <- function(result, output_dir = file.path("data_files", "rough")) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (corrected in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
        plot <- rough_convergence_plot(result, corrected)
        name <- if (corrected)
            "conv_h_rough_corrected"
        else "conv_h_rough_raw"
        for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, ".", extension)),
            plot, width = 6.2, height = 4.7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    invisible(output_dir)
}

rough_tau_mesh <- function(J, kappa = 4) {
    stopifnot(length(J) == 1L, is.finite(J), J == as.integer(J), J >= 3L, J <= 22L, length(kappa) == 1L, is.finite(kappa),
        kappa > 0)
    h <- 2^-J
    cells <- as.integer(2^(J - 1L))
    n <- cells - 1L
    C <- Matrix::bandSparse(n, k = c(-1L, 0L, 1L), diagonals = list(rep(2 * h/3, n - 1L), rep(8 * h/3, n), rep(2 *
        h/3, n - 1L)))
    G <- Matrix::bandSparse(n, k = c(-1L, 0L, 1L), diagonals = list(rep(-4/h, n - 1L), rep(8/h, n), rep(-4/h, n -
        1L)))
    j <- seq_len(J - 1L)
    x <- seq_len(n) * h
    theta <- pi * 2^j * h
    B <- outer(x, 2^j, function(x, k) sinpi(x * k)) * rep(4 * h * (sin(theta/2)/(theta/2))^2, each = n)
    list(J = J, h = h, C = C, K = kappa^2 * C + G, B = B, j = j, kappa = kappa, load = as.numeric(B %*% (1/j)),
        x = x)
}

rough_tau_projection <- function(mesh, quadrature_order = 16L) {
    stopifnot(quadrature_order >= 8L, quadrature_order == as.integer(quadrature_order))
    factor <- Matrix::Cholesky(Matrix::forceSymmetric(mesh$C), LDL = FALSE)
    P <- as.matrix(Matrix::solve(factor, mesh$B, system = "A"))
    rule <- statmod::gauss.quad(quadrature_order, "legendre")
    z <- (rule$nodes + 1)/2
    n <- nrow(P)
    left <- rbind(rep(0, ncol(P)), P)
    right <- rbind(P, rep(0, ncol(P)))
    starts <- (0:n) * mesh$h
    residual_gram <- matrix(0, ncol(P), ncol(P))
    for (q in seq_along(z)) {
        exact <- outer(starts + mesh$h * z[q], 2^mesh$j, function(x, k) sinpi(x * k))
        residual <- exact - ((1 - z[q]) * left + z[q] * right)
        residual_gram <- residual_gram + 2 * mesh$h * rule$weights[q] * Matrix::crossprod(residual)
    }
    list(P = P, residual_gram = residual_gram)
}

rough_tau_solve <- function(mesh, alpha, N, order, diffusion, T_final = 1, projection = rough_tau_projection(mesh),
    tail_tolerance = 1e-13, return_states = FALSE) {
    stopifnot(N >= 1, N == as.integer(N), is.finite(T_final), T_final > 0)
    tau <- T_final/N
    operator <- rough_operator(mesh, alpha, tau, order, diffusion)
    tail <- rough_tail(mesh$J, alpha, diffusion, mesh$kappa, T_final, tail_tolerance)
    general <- function(A) as(as(A, "generalMatrix"), "CsparseMatrix")
    started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    result <- rough_matrix_evolve_cpp(general(mesh$C), lapply(operator$partial_fraction_terms, general), operator$residues,
        operator$remainder, mesh$load, projection$P, projection$residual_gram, rough_rates(mesh$j, alpha, diffusion,
            mesh$kappa), mesh$j, tau, as.integer(N), tail$squared, return_states)
    result$elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
    result$tau <- tau
    result$N <- N
    result$order <- order
    result$alpha <- alpha
    result$diffusion <- diffusion
    result$J <- mesh$J
    result$n_solver_nodes <- nrow(mesh$C)
    result$tail <- tail
    result$transfer_reconstruction_error <- operator$transfer$reconstruction_error
    result
}

rough_tau_parameters <- function() {
    alpha <- seq(0.5, 1.9, 0.2)
    kappa <- 4
    list(alpha = alpha, J = c(20L, 16L, 13L, 11L, 10L, 9L, 8L, 8L), diffusion = (kappa^2 + 4 * pi^2)^(-alpha/2),
        rational_orders = c(20L, rep(14L, 7L)), N = c(5L, 10L, 20L, 40L, 80L, 160L), fit_indices = 4:6, T_final = 1,
        kappa = kappa, projection_quadrature = 16L, tail_tolerance = 1e-13, forcing = "same fixed infinite L2 forcing as conv_in_h_rough",
        reconstruction = "right-constant backward Euler", error_integration = "exact time moments, stable projection residual, certified infinite tail")
}

rough_tau_run_experiment <- function(parameters = rough_tau_parameters(), output_file = "data_files/rough_tau_results.rds",
    checkpoint_dir = tempfile("rough-tau-"), workers = 3L, root = getwd(), cache_dir = tempdir()) {
    stopifnot(length(parameters$alpha) == length(parameters$J), length(parameters$alpha) == length(parameters$diffusion),
        length(parameters$alpha) == length(parameters$rational_orders), all(parameters$fit_indices %in% seq_along(parameters$N)),
        workers >= 1)
    dir.create(checkpoint_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    rough_compile_solver(root, cache_dir)
    provenance <- list(parameters=parameters,sources=tools::md5sum(file.path(root,"brasilfunc.Rmd")))
    run_alpha <- function(a) {
        checkpoint <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, sprintf("alpha%03d.rds", round(100 * parameters$alpha[a])))
        if (file.exists(checkpoint)) {
            saved <- readRDS(checkpoint)
            if (!identical(saved$provenance, provenance))
                stop("Temporal checkpoint source/settings mismatch.")
            return(saved$values)
        }
        message(sprintf("Preparing tau curve: alpha=%.1f, J=%d", parameters$alpha[a], parameters$J[a]))
        mesh <- rough_tau_mesh(parameters$J[a], parameters$kappa)
        projection <- rough_tau_projection(mesh, parameters$projection_quadrature)
        values <- lapply(parameters$N, function(N) {
            value <- rough_tau_solve(mesh, parameters$alpha[a], N, parameters$rational_orders[a], parameters$diffusion[a],
                parameters$T_final, projection, parameters$tail_tolerance)
            value$states <- value$final_state <- NULL
            message(sprintf("alpha=%.1f, N=%d, error=%.10g, %.2fs", parameters$alpha[a], N, value$error, value$elapsed))
            value
        })
        saveRDS(list(provenance = provenance, values = values), checkpoint)
        values
    }
    safe_alpha <- function(a) tryCatch(run_alpha(a), error = function(e) list(failed = TRUE, message = conditionMessage(e)))
    curves <- if (workers > 1L && .Platform$OS.type == "unix")
        parallel::mclapply(seq_along(parameters$alpha), safe_alpha, mc.cores = min(workers, length(parameters$alpha)),
            mc.preschedule = FALSE)
    else lapply(seq_along(parameters$alpha), safe_alpha)
    failed <- vapply(curves, function(x) !is.list(x) || isTRUE(x$failed) || inherits(x, "try-error"), logical(1))
    if (any(failed))
        stop("Temporal matrix experiment failed: ", paste(vapply(curves[failed], function(x) if (is.list(x))
            x$message
        else as.character(x), character(1)), collapse = "; "))
    errors <- vapply(curves, function(x) vapply(x, `[[`, numeric(1), "error"), numeric(length(parameters$N)))
    tau <- parameters$T_final/parameters$N
    fit <- parameters$fit_indices
    slope <- function(e) unname(coef(stats::lm(log10(e[fit]) ~ log10(tau[fit])))[2])
    observed <- apply(errors, 2L, slope)
    result <- list(parameters = parameters, tau = tau, errors = errors, rates = data.frame(alpha = parameters$alpha,
        theoretical = 1, observed = observed, relative_error_percent = 100 * abs(observed - 1)), curves = curves,
        provenance = provenance, generated_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z", tz = "Asia/Riyadh"),
        session_info = utils::sessionInfo())
    saveRDS(result, output_file)
    result
}

rough_tau_convergence_plot <- function(result) {
    p <- result$parameters
    errors <- result$errors
    fit <- p$fit_indices
    constants <- apply(errors[fit, , drop = FALSE]/result$tau[fit], 2L, function(x) exp(mean(log(x))))
    frame <- expand.grid(index = seq_along(result$tau), column = seq_along(p$alpha))
    frame$tau <- result$tau[frame$index]
    frame$error <- as.vector(errors)
    frame$alpha <- factor(p$alpha[frame$column], levels = p$alpha)
    guide <- frame
    guide$error <- guide$tau * constants[guide$column]
    ggplot2::ggplot(frame, ggplot2::aes(tau, error, color = alpha, group = alpha)) + ggplot2::geom_line(data = guide,
        linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.75) + ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.1) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = result$tau, labels = function(x) paste0("1/", round(1/x))) + ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
        ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0.05, end = 0.85) + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~alpha, ncol = 2L,
        labeller = ggplot2::label_both) + ggplot2::labs(x = expression(tau ~ "(log scale)"), y = expression(E[tau]),
        color = expression(alpha), title = "Temporal convergence with rough forcing") + ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13,
            face = "bold"))
}

rough_tau_save_figures <- function(result, output_dir = "data_files/rough_tau") {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    plot <- rough_tau_convergence_plot(result)
    name <- "conv_tau_rough"
    for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, ".", extension)), plot,
        width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    invisible(output_dir)
}
```

## Sparse time stepping for rough data

```{r brasil-functions-5, eval=TRUE}
rough_compile_solver <- function(root=getwd(),cache_dir=tempdir()) {
  target <- environment(rough_compile_solver)
  if(!exists("rough_matrix_evolve_cpp",envir=target,inherits=FALSE))
    Rcpp::sourceCpp(code=r"----(// [[Rcpp::depends(RcppEigen)]]
// [[Rcpp::plugins(cpp11)]]
#include <RcppEigen.h>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
using Eigen::VectorXd;
using Eigen::MatrixXd;
using Eigen::SparseMatrix;
typedef Eigen::SimplicialLDLT<SparseMatrix<double> > SparseFactor;

static double one_minus_average(double z) {
  if (z >= .05) return 1.0 + std::expm1(-z)/z;
  double term = z/2.0, value = term;
  for (int k=2; k<=16; ++k) { term *= -z/(k+1.0); value += term; }
  return value;
}

static double exponential_variance(double z) {
  if (z >= .05) {
    double average = -std::expm1(-z)/z;
    return -std::expm1(-2*z)/(2*z) - average*average;
  }
  // Centered 8-point Gauss rule; expm1 retains the O(z) deviations.
  static const double nodes[8] = {
    .0198550717512319,.101666761293187,.237233795041836,.408282678752175,
    .591717321247825,.762766204958164,.898333238706813,.980144928248768};
  static const double weights[8] = {
    .0506142681451881,.111190517226687,.156853322938944,.181341891689181,
    .181341891689181,.156853322938944,.111190517226687,.0506142681451881};
  double shift = one_minus_average(z), value = 0;
  for (int q=0; q<8; ++q) {
    double deviation = std::expm1(-z*nodes[q]) + shift;
    value += weights[q]*deviation*deviation;
  }
  return value;
}

// Every time step applies the shifted FEM matrix solves. No eigenvalues or
// modal recurrence of the discrete operator are used in this routine.
// [[Rcpp::export]]
Rcpp::List rough_matrix_evolve_cpp(
    const Eigen::MappedSparseMatrix<double>& C_in, Rcpp::List matrices,
    Eigen::VectorXd residues, double remainder, Eigen::VectorXd load,
    Eigen::MatrixXd projection, Eigen::MatrixXd residual_gram,
    Eigen::VectorXd rates, Eigen::VectorXd mode_j,
    double tau, int n_steps, double tail_squared, bool return_states = false) {
  SparseMatrix<double> C = C_in;
  int n = C.rows(), m = residues.size(), modes = rates.size();
  if (n_steps < 1 || tau <= 0 || matrices.size()!=m || load.size()!=n ||
      projection.rows()!=n || projection.cols()!=modes || mode_j.size()!=modes ||
      residual_gram.rows()!=modes || residual_gram.cols()!=modes)
    Rcpp::stop("Invalid rough matrix solver dimensions.");
  SparseFactor mass_factor;
  mass_factor.compute(C);
  if (mass_factor.info()!=Eigen::Success) Rcpp::stop("Mass factorization failed.");
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<SparseFactor> > factors;
  for (int i=0; i<m; ++i) {
    SparseMatrix<double> A = Rcpp::as<SparseMatrix<double> >(matrices[i]);
    factors.emplace_back(new SparseFactor());
    factors.back()->compute(A);
    if (factors.back()->info()!=Eigen::Success) Rcpp::stop("Shifted factorization failed.");
  }
  VectorXd u=VectorXd::Zero(n), rhs(n), next(n), mean(modes), delta(n);
  VectorXd amplitude(modes), average_shift(modes), variance(modes);
  for (int j=0; j<modes; ++j) {
    amplitude[j]=1.0/(mode_j[j]*rates[j]);
    average_shift[j]=one_minus_average(rates[j]*tau);
    variance[j]=exponential_variance(rates[j]*tau);
  }
  MatrixXd states(return_states ? n : 0, return_states ? n_steps+1 : 0);
  if (return_states) states.col(0)=u;
  double total=0, compensation=0;
  for (int k=1; k<=n_steps; ++k) {
    if ((k & 4095)==0) Rcpp::checkUserInterrupt();
    rhs.noalias()=C*u;
    rhs.noalias()+=tau*load;
    next=remainder*mass_factor.solve(rhs);
    for (int i=0; i<m; ++i) next.noalias()+=residues[i]*factors[i]->solve(rhs);
    u.swap(next);
    double variance_sum=0;
    for (int j=0; j<modes; ++j) {
      double z=rates[j]*tau*(k-1.0), decay=std::exp(-z);
      mean[j]=amplitude[j]*(-std::expm1(-z)+decay*average_shift[j]);
      variance_sum+=amplitude[j]*amplitude[j]*decay*decay*variance[j];
    }
    delta.noalias()=u-projection*mean;
    double value=tau*(delta.dot(C*delta)+mean.dot(residual_gram*mean)+variance_sum);
    if (!std::isfinite(value) || value < 0) Rcpp::stop("Invalid squared matrix error.");
    double adjusted=value-compensation, updated=total+adjusted;
    compensation=(updated-total)-adjusted;
    total=updated;
    if (return_states) states.col(k)=u;
  }
  return Rcpp::List::create(Rcpp::Named("error")=std::sqrt(total+tail_squared),
    Rcpp::Named("resolved_squared")=total, Rcpp::Named("tail_squared")=tail_squared,
    Rcpp::Named("final_state")=u, Rcpp::Named("states")=states);
}
)----",env=target,cacheDir=cache_dir,
                    showOutput=FALSE,verbose=FALSE)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```
